arxiv.title: Heads of Security: Learned Attention Gates Improve Prompt Injection Robustness
arxiv.abstract: We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. HoS learns how each head should redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions. We evaluate HoS on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B. We compare it against SecAlign++, a state-of-the-art finetuning-based defense, and ASIDE, a defense that, like ours, builds instruction-data separation into the model architecture. We show that HoS offers greater robustness to adaptive attacks, better performance on standard utility benchmarks, and matches top performance on standard agentic prompt injection benchmarks. More specifically, the black-box RL-Hammer attack reaches 97% ASR against GPT-OSS-20B and 85% against SecAlign, but only 10% against HoS. Claudini, a state-of-the-art white-box attack, strengthened against HoS through autoresearch, requires 3 times more FLOPs to reach the same ASR on HoS as it does on GPT-OSS-20B or SecAlign. HoS preserves base-model utility across standard multiple-choice benchmarks and prompting setups, whereas SecAlign and ASIDE degrade in few-shot settings. On agentic benchmarks with static attacks, HoS and SecAlign perform similarly and substantially improve the security-utility trade-off over the base model. ASIDE struggles with tool use, achieving only 10% utility. These results show that prompt injection robustness can be achieved and improved through targeted attention interventions.
arxiv.titleZh: 安全注意力头：学习式注意力门提升提示注入鲁棒性
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对提示注入防御，提出 Heads of Security（HoS）：用少量可学习的逐头注意力门，让每个注意力头在可信与不可信 token 之间重新分配注意力，从架构层面强制指令与数据分离。在 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 与 GPT-OSS-20B 上，黑盒 RL-Hammer 攻击对 GPT-OSS-20B 与 SecAlign 的攻击成功率分别达 97% 与 85%，对 HoS 仅 10%；白盒攻击 Claudini 要在 HoS 上达到同等攻击成功率需约 3 倍 FLOPs。HoS 在多项选择与 few-shot 场景保持基座模型效用，而 SecAlign 与 ASIDE 在 few-shot 下退化，ASIDE 在工具使用任务上效用仅 10%。
arxiv.reason: 注意力门做提示注入防御，属对齐与 Agent 安全扎实工作

arxiv.title: Attention as Lattice Gauge Theory: Relations Interact Only Through Wilson Loops
arxiv.abstract: Relations compose through the entity they share - Alice is Bob's mother and Bob is Carol's father, so Alice is Carol's grandmother - and the order matters, since a father's mother is not a mother's father; verifying a composed relation means closing the loop. We show that if each entity's coordinate frame may be rotated independently (per-entity frame freedom), three things follow. In the pure-gauge sector, relations that share no cycle cannot interact at all. The only gauge-invariant score of a triangle is a class function of its holonomy $H = T_{ij} T_{jk} T_{ki}$ - a Wilson loop. And the only equivariant update of an edge is $U = Ψ(H)\, T_{ij}$ with $Ψ$ conjugation-equivariant. Edge attention by Wilson loops is therefore not one design among many but the unique form the symmetry permits. Three communities hold pieces of this form: the commuting-operator embeddings of knowledge graphs are its abelian (commuting) sector; AlphaFold's triangle update and the Edge Transformer have its shape - an edge updated through the third vertex - without its constraints; and lattice QCD builds it equivariantly on lattices. We instantiate the equivariant sub-family on general relational graphs as holonomy attention. With no training and composition alone, it infers unobserved $S_4$ relations on sparse graphs at 0.88 with a fifth of the edges corrupted, at or slightly below specialist synchronization algorithms, where every commutative architecture is capped at 0.083; its holonomy score flags corrupted triangles at AUC 0.99 where commuting scores are capped at 0.76 by a second selection rule, and it separates clusters without labels.
arxiv.comment: 7 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the 9th Workshop on Machine Learning and the Physical Sciences (ML4PS 2026), co-located with NeurIPS 2026
arxiv.titleZh: 注意力即格点规范理论：关系仅通过 Wilson 环相互作用
arxiv.summaryZh: 关系复合依赖共享实体且顺序敏感，验证复合关系需要闭合回路。论文证明：若每个实体的坐标系可独立旋转（逐实体规范自由），则纯规范扇区中不共享循环的关系完全无法相互作用，三角形唯一的规范不变评分是其 holonomy 的类函数即 Wilson 环，边的唯一等变更新为 U=Ψ(H)T_ij，由此把知识图谱的交换算子嵌入、AlphaFold 三角更新与格点 QCD 统一到同一形式。据此在一般关系图上实例化 holonomy attention，无需训练、仅靠复合即在五分之一边被污染的稀疏图上以 0.88 推断未观测的 S4 关系（交换性架构上限 0.083），并以 AUC 0.99 标记被污染的三角形。
arxiv.reason: 规范理论视角的等变注意力，理论新颖但无 LLM 实验，方向擦边

arxiv.title: KPPax: preprocess differentiable kinetic ODE for machine learning in atmospheric chemistry
arxiv.abstract: Atmospheric chemical mechanisms are commonly distributed in the language of the Kinetic PreProcessor (KPP), which generates efficient Fortran or C code but does not fit into the differentiable programming frameworks in which machine-learning models are developed. We present KPPax, a kinetic preprocessor that generates differentiable, just-in-time compiled, and vectorisable chemistry code in JAX from mechanisms written in the KPP language. KPPax evaluates the rate law with sparse operations in log space, which keeps it differentiable, and integrates the stiff system with the implicit solvers and the forward- and reverse-mode adjoints of the \texttt{diffrax} library, so that exact sensitivities are obtained without hand-derived adjoint code. We demonstrate two applications with the POLLU benchmark mechanism. In the first, the Fisher information matrix computed from an automatically differentiated Jacobian predicts, before any fit, which of the 25 rate coefficients a flow-tube-like design can identify, and noisy synthetic estimation confirms the predicted uncertainties of the nine identifiable rate coefficients to within about 30\% while revealing clusters of fast reactions of which only ratios are constrained. In the second, a neural-network correction of an emission inventory is trained offline on per-scenario 4D-Var retrievals and then fine-tuned online through the chemical model, which reduces the error of the biogenic correction by a factor of 2.4--5 and recovers information on low-temperature emissions that the individual retrievals lose. KPPax makes KPP mechanisms directly usable for parameter estimation and hybrid physics--machine-learning modelling.
arxiv.titleZh: KPPax：面向大气化学机器学习的可微动力学 ODE 预处理工具
arxiv.summaryZh: 大气化学机理常以 KPP 语言发布，其生成的 Fortran/C 代码无法接入可微编程框架。KPPax 将 KPP 机理转译为 JAX 中可微、即时编译且可向量化的化学代码：速率定律在对数空间用稀疏运算保持可微性，刚性系统则借助 diffrax 的隐式求解器与正反向伴随，无需手写伴随即可获得精确敏感性。在 POLLU 基准上，由自动微分 Jacobian 算出的 Fisher 信息矩阵在拟合前即预测出 25 个速率系数中可辨识的 9 个，合成实验的不确定性误差约 30%；基于 4D-Var 检索离线训练并在线微调的神经网络排放修正，把生物源修正误差降低 2.4–5 倍。该工作使 KPP 机理可直接用于参数估计与物理—机器学习混合建模。
arxiv.reason: 可微科学计算工具，与 LLM 主线无关，仅沾 AI4Science 边

arxiv.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also come from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges. We argue that such failures may not provide useful learning signal, and may even be harmful; and thus it is essential to curate which tasks are provided to the prompt optimizer for better performance. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization. In particular, GEPA-Curator consists of two components: task curation, which filters out tasks that are likely to provide noisy or unreliable learning signals, and prior success retrieval, which selectively retrieves past successful trajectories for a task and provides them as additional context to the prompt optimizer. We evaluate GEPA-Curator on GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and $τ$-bench, using both Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 5 as optimizer models. GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds the mean performance of both baselines, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA and 21.2% over ACE.
arxiv.titleZh: GEPA-Curator：面向自我改进智能体的精选学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 多轮智能体任务中的失败轨迹未必提供有效学习信号：失败可能源自提示词缺陷、harness 限制、执行随机性或评审噪声，直接用于反思式提示优化甚至有害。GEPA-Curator 在 GEPA 之上加入两个组件：任务精选过滤掉学习信号噪声大、不可靠的任务；先验成功轨迹检索针对具体任务取回历史成功轨迹，作为额外上下文提供给提示优化器。在 GoBrowse、ALFWorld、AppWorld 与 τ-bench 上，以 Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 Claude Opus 5 作为优化器模型，平均性能匹配或超过基线，相对 GEPA 最高提升 20.7%，相对 ACE 最高提升 21.2%。该工作说明，对智能体经验做筛选是提升提示自改进效率的可行路径。
arxiv.reason: 智能体提示自改进，精选学习信号，四个基准验证扎实

arxiv.title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
arxiv.abstract: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? To evaluate this ability, we introduce LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. Separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, review tool designs, and evaluate reports for correctness and experimental support using the altered physical laws and exploration records. These records guide scene evolution for further exploration, allowing the full cycle to run without human intervention. Among 12 LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7%, while the other 11 score 0%. The exploration records reveal uninvestigated anomalies and only partial identification of the altered physical laws.
arxiv.titleZh: LLM 能否通过自由探索发现隐藏的物理定律？
arxiv.summaryZh: 构建 LongChang 自动化框架，生成一条或多条物理定律被改动的模拟世界，让 LLM 扮演探索者自行操作物体、搭建工具并提出研究问题，全程不给定研究任务、也不提示改动何在；另有独立 LLM agent 负责生成与审查场景、审核工具设计，并依据改动后的定律与探索记录判断报告的正确性与实验支撑，探索记录再驱动场景演化，形成无人干预的闭环。在 12 个模型中仅 GPT-6-Astra 的发现率达到 16.7%，其余 11 个均为 0%；探索记录显示，大量异常现象未被追查，改动定律也只被部分识别。该工作为开放式科学发现型 Agent 提供了可自动运行的环境与评测范式。
arxiv.reason: 科研智能体自主发现规律，环境与多 agent 评测闭环扎实

arxiv.title: Scaling Laws for Tool-Use Agents via Controllable Environment Synthesis
arxiv.abstract: We explore how to build performant large language model (LLM) tool-use agents that complete complex, multi-step tasks. Specifically, we study how data composition in synthetically generated tool-use environments affects the training of such agents. To do so, we propose the SynthAPI pipeline, which explicitly controls the diversity of generated environments along the axes of tools, tasks, and the databases on which the tools operate. By systematically varying SynthAPI's generation controls in 458,752 tasks across 849 trained models of four different sizes, we derive a scaling law that predicts downstream tool-use agent generalization based on the scale and composition of the synthesized environments. These predictable relationships reveal several lessons for scaling tool-use agent data. As data budgets grow, scaling tool and database diversity becomes more effective than increasing the number of tasks, and increasing data complexity yields larger gains. Scaling according to these findings yields agents that outperform models trained on data from prior work in large-scale tool-use agent and synthetic environment generation across four evaluation benchmarks.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过可控环境合成实现工具使用 Agent 的缩放律
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究合成工具使用环境中数据组成如何影响 LLM Agent 训练，提出 SynthAPI 流程，沿工具、任务与数据库三个维度显式控制生成环境的多样性。在 849 个不同规模模型、458,752 个任务上系统变化生成参数，拟合出由合成环境规模与组成预测下游工具使用泛化的缩放律。规律显示：数据预算增大时，扩展工具与数据库多样性比增加任务数量更有效，提高数据复杂度收益更大；按此结论扩展数据后，在四个评测基准上超过此前大规模工具使用数据与合成环境方法训练的模型。
arxiv.reason: 环境合成缩放律，直击 Agentic RL 数据侧核心

arxiv.title: MuonGS: Pretraining LLMs with Relaxed Weight-Norm Control
arxiv.abstract: Weight decay and explicit weight-norm constraints improve optimizer performance in language model pretraining, yet a unified understanding of why such control helps and how much is needed remains incomplete. We analyze norm control in Muon over the entire training trajectory using the \emph{accumulated effective learning rate}, $C_T=\sum_{t<T}η_t/\|W_t\|_F$, where $η_t$ is the nominal learning rate and $η_t/\|W_t\|_F$ is the effective learning rate relative to the weight norm. For bounded update directions, accumulation over any training interval bounds relative weight displacement. We show that vanilla Muon can accumulate only logarithmically, potentially limiting exploration and helping explain its slower empirical progress, whereas MuonW and MuonH guarantee at least linear accumulation under the stated conditions. Going beyond bounded-norm control, we show that sufficiently slow norm growth guarantees faster accumulation than the logarithmic worst case, opening up less restrictive optimizer designs. Based on this insight, we propose MuonGS, which uses Gram--Schmidt (GS) projection to remove the radial component of each Muon update without fixing the weight norm. With bounded update directions and a constant nominal learning rate, we prove that the weight norm grows at most proportionally to $\sqrt{t}$ after $t$ steps. Consequently, MuonGS guarantees $C_T=Ω(\sqrt{T})$, with accumulation sustained even in later training. Further, for smooth scale-invariant objectives we establish its $O(T^{-1/2})$ stationarity guarantee. In pretraining experiments with 160M- and 400M-parameter dense models as well as a 135M active- and 1B total- parameter MoE model, MuonGS achieves lower validation perplexity than MuonH at long training horizons. In particular, for the dense model it achieves an estimated token-equivalent speedup up to about $15\%$ at matched validation loss to MuonH.
arxiv.titleZh: MuonGS:以松弛权重范数控制预训练 LLM
arxiv.summaryZh: 权重衰减与显式权重范数约束为何能提升语言模型预训练效果、需要多强的约束，目前缺乏统一解释。该工作用累积有效学习率 C_T=Σ_t η_t/‖W_t‖_F 刻画整条训练轨迹，证明原始 Muon 只能实现对数级累积，而 MuonW、MuonH 在给定条件下至少线性累积;据此提出 MuonGS，用 Gram-Schmidt 投影去掉每次 Muon 更新的径向分量而不固定权重范数，证明权重范数至多按 √t 增长、C_T=Ω(√T)，并为光滑尺度不变目标给出 O(T^{-1/2}) 的驻点保证。在 160M/400M 稠密模型与 135M 激活/1B 总参数 MoE 的预训练中，长训练周期下 MuonGS 的验证困惑度低于 MuonH，稠密模型在匹配验证损失下约有 15% 的 token 等效加速。
arxiv.reason: Muon 优化器新设计与权重范数理论分析，直击预训练与优化器方向

arxiv.title: Multi-State Linear Attention with Generalized Second-Order Routing
arxiv.abstract: Self-attention plays a key role in long-sequence modeling, but its quadratic time complexity fundamentally limits the scaling of Large Language Models. Recently, Multi-State Linear Attention (MSLA) mechanisms have been proposed to make sequence modeling more efficient by splitting the context into segments and compressing each in its own memory state. MSLA aggregates the information extracted from each memory state using only the mean alignment between a query and each segment's keys, ignoring how the alignment is distributed within the segment. In order to model the relevance of a segment to a query more comprehensively and incorporate the variance of the alignment in the aggregation, we propose MERLIN (MomEnt Routing for multi-state LINear attention), a method that tracks the first and second moments of each segment's keys. Using the moments of keys, a query can recover both the mean and the variance of its alignment with each segment to perform a more content-aware aggregation of per-state readouts. Experiments on multi-state variants of Gated DeltaNet-1.3B and Mamba-2-780M show that MERLIN consistently outperforms existing aggregation methods on various long-context tasks. In particular, MERLIN outperforms baselines on RULER needle-in-a-haystack and long-context QA (+8.3% for Gated DeltaNet-1.3B and +7.0% for Mamba-2-780M) and diverse subtasks in LongBench (+13.5% and +12.0%). It even outperforms baselines that consume 4x more memory. MERLIN provides a simple and general routing mechanism for improving long-context capabilities of MSLA models.
arxiv.titleZh: 多状态线性注意力与广义二阶路由
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有MSLA把上下文切段并为每段维护独立的记忆状态，但聚合各状态读出时只用到query与段内key的均值对齐，忽略了段内对齐分布的方差。MERLIN为每段key同时维护一阶与二阶矩，使query能恢复它与该段对齐的均值与方差，从而按内容做更精细的路由聚合。在Gated DeltaNet-1.3B与Mamba-2-780M的多状态变体上，RULER needle-in-a-haystack与长文QA分别提升8.3%与7.0%，LongBench多个子任务提升13.5%与12.0%，并超过内存占用高出4倍的基线。该机制实现简单、可作为通用插件接入，适合用于改造长上下文线性注意力模型。
arxiv.reason: 线性注意力长上下文聚合改进，命中架构与长上下文方向

arxiv.title: Metacognitive Decoding: Efficient Inference for Diffusion Language Agents
arxiv.abstract: Diffusion language models offer a promising path to efficient agents through parallel token generation. However, efficient interaction requires adapting both where computation is spent and how much text is generated. We introduce a metacognitive controller that guides diffusion generation according to the needs of the current response and the agent's interaction with the environment. It learns when to finalize tokens and how far generation should extend, reducing overall computation within responses. Our controller, a lightweight plug-in for the diffusion backbone, is trained on agent trajectories to balance correctness and generation cost. This approach connects the agent's generation process to the interaction the agent serves. Experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that our approach reduces inference FLOPs by 20.6% on average compared with the most efficient baseline, while maintaining competitive task accuracy. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of our approach.
arxiv.titleZh: 元认知解码:面向扩散语言智能体的高效推理
arxiv.summaryZh: 扩散语言模型通过并行 token 生成，为高效智能体提供了一条可行路径，但高效交互需要同时自适应地决定计算投在哪里、生成多少文本。为此提出元认知控制器，作为扩散骨干的轻量插件，依据当前回答的需求与智能体同环境的交互，学习何时确定 token、生成应延伸到何处，并用智能体轨迹训练以在正确性与生成成本之间取得平衡。在五个基准上，推理 FLOPs 相比最高效基线平均降低 20.6%，任务准确率仍保持相当水平。
arxiv.reason: 扩散语言模型推理优化，画像中扩散模型一律归低分方向

arxiv.title: What Improves During Pretraining? Tracking Knowledge Acquisition with Point-in-Time Models
arxiv.abstract: Language models pretrained on web corpora collected over multiple years learn both general and domain-specific knowledge. How these different kinds of knowledge are learned as pretraining progresses remains unclear. Recent point-in-time models trained on web snapshots from different years provide a way to probe how knowledge prevalence varies over time. Using these models, we propose a temporal variability score (TVS), defined as the coefficient of variation of an item's negative log-likelihood across models. A higher score suggests that the knowledge may be less consistently represented across years of web text. We evaluate six benchmarks covering diverse topics using six models from multiple open-source model families. We find that low- and high-TVS items are learned similarly early in training, but high-TVS items improve faster later on. At the end of the pretraining run, high-TVS items outperform low-TVS items in 34 of 36 model-benchmark settings, with an average advantage of 7.3 points of chance-normalized accuracy. This pattern is most robust on knowledge-intensive tasks, even when comparing items of similar difficulty. Our findings reveal differences in how knowledge is learned over the course of pretraining, with temporal variability providing a diagnostic of these learning dynamics beyond aggregate benchmark scores.
arxiv.comment: Accepted to AACL 2026. This version corrects minor errors in the appendix
arxiv.titleZh: 预训练过程中什么在提升？用时间点模型追踪知识习得
arxiv.summaryZh: 预训练过程中通用知识与领域知识各自如何被习得仍不清楚。该工作利用在不同年份网页快照上训练的时间点模型，提出时间变异性分数(TVS)，即同一题目在各年份模型上负对数似然的变异系数，用以刻画知识在网络文本中的时间分布差异。覆盖六个主题基准、多个开源模型家族的六个模型共 36 组设置后发现:高 TVS 与低 TVS 题目在训练早期学习速度相近，但高 TVS 题目在后期提升更快，最终在 34/36 组设置中反超，平均 chance-normalized accuracy 领先 7.3 分，且在知识密集任务上最稳健。该指标可作为超越聚合基准分数的预训练学习动态诊断工具。
arxiv.reason: 预训练知识习得动态分析，方法清晰、实验系统

arxiv.title: Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions
arxiv.abstract: When an LLM group's discussion is compressed into a short memory for a final decision maker, what should the memory keep? Two natural heuristics keep the rarest claims or the claims relevant to the decision criteria. On hidden-profile tasks both look attractive, because how widely a fact is held is confounded with whether it helps. We introduce CrossProfile, a diagnostic benchmark of 60 templates with automatically verified answer keys, in which the ownership of supporting, decoy, and irrelevant facts is crossed while their text is held fixed (480 tasks). Across Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and two DeepSeek models, both heuristics fail in predictable places. Selecting by relevance readmits decoys, because decoys are on topic: even a perfect relevance filter loses 23 to 31 points to rarest-first selection in the classic hidden-profile configuration. Rarest-first selection is no better than random selection on average and wins only where the rare facts happen to be the useful ones. In both cases accuracy follows the balance of evidence the memory keeps, not the policy that kept it. The decision model adds a third failure, a form of social proof: it gives extra weight to facts attributed to many agents. Removing the attribution tags, or reassigning them at random with line order fixed, raises accuracy in the classic configuration by 13 to 24 points. In natural discussions the evidence is lost before any memory acts: the complete transcript yields lower accuracy than no notes at all.
arxiv.titleZh: 稀有、相关，却仍然错误:记忆如何使 LLM 群体决策失效
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究多智能体 LLM 讨论被压缩成简短记忆、再交给最终决策者时该保留什么:构建 CrossProfile 诊断基准，含 60 个模板、自动校验答案键、共 480 个任务，交叉支持性、诱饵与无关事实的归属关系，但固定文本。在 Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B 与两个 DeepSeek 模型上，按相关性筛选会重新引入诱饵——经典 hidden-profile 设置中，即使理想的相关性过滤也比 rarest-first 低 23–31 分，而 rarest-first 平均仅与随机相当;准确率取决于记忆保留的证据平衡，而不取决于筛选策略。决策模型还会给由多个 agent 归属的事实额外权重，即社会证明;去除归属标签或固定行序随机重排归属标签，可使经典配置准确率提升 13–24 分;自然讨论中完整转录本的准确率甚至低于完全不给笔记。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体记忆压缩与可靠性评测，方法扎实，命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: EnvSched: Environment-Aware Scheduling for Rollout-Efficient Agent Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: As executable environments for language agents scale, generating and verifying their rollouts becomes increasingly expensive. Under finite rollout budgets, this raises an important question: can data management at the environment level make agentic reinforcement learning (RL) more efficient by organizing, evaluating, and scheduling task instances together with the environments that determine their tools, states, transitions, and verification? To address this question, we introduce EnvSched (Environment-aware Scheduling), an online scheduler that learns from rollout history. EnvSched assigns scheduling value through two complementary modeling choices: exploitation prioritizes tasks likely to provide informative reward differences, while coverage spreads each batch across underobserved environments and interaction patterns. EnvSched organizes environment--task pairs as nodes in a dual-relation graph, with within-environment edges capturing task semantics and shared tool, state, and verifier structure, and cross-environment edges capturing abstract execution and reward topology. By propagating historical rollout statistics along both edge types, it predicts within-task reward variance. These predictions guide a scheduler that allocates each batch to tasks with high predicted reward variance and underobserved environments and tasks. Environment quotas and a similarity penalty further limit concentration and redundancy, yielding informative and diverse batches without additional pilot rollouts. In RL on Qwen3-8B, EnvSched achieves an average score of 48.81 across BFCL-v3, tau-Bench, and ACEBench-Agent after 40 training steps, exceeding the highest score attained by random task selection after 120 steps. It also improves downstream performance across model sizes at the same training budget.
arxiv.titleZh: EnvSched：面向 rollout 高效智能体强化学习的环境感知调度
arxiv.summaryZh: 在智能体强化学习中，rollout 的生成与验证成本随可执行环境规模增长而急剧上升，如何在有限 rollout 预算下进行环境级数据管理是关键问题。EnvSched 把环境—任务对组织成双关系图：环境内的边刻画任务语义以及共享的工具、状态与验证器结构，跨环境的边刻画抽象的执行与奖励拓扑，并沿两类边传播历史 rollout 统计，以预测任务内的奖励方差。调度器结合利用与覆盖这两种策略，优先选择预测方差高以及环境、交互模式被观察不足的任务，并通过环境配额与相似度惩罚抑制集中与冗余，无需额外 pilot rollout。在 Qwen3-8B 上训练 40 步后，BFCL-v3、tau-Bench 与 ACEBench-Agent 平均得分 48.81，超过随机任务选择训练 120 步的最高成绩，并在相同预算下提升多种模型规模的下游表现。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL 的 rollout 调度与数据管理，命中后训练与 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: GAS-PFN: Graph-Aware Spatiotemporal Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Zero-Shot Traffic Forecasting
arxiv.abstract: Traffic forecasting requires modeling complex temporal dynamics and the spatial dependencies imposed by road topology. Supervised graph-based models achieve strong performance, but are often trained for a particular dataset and sensor graph, making deployment to new or evolving networks costly. Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) offer a zero-shot alternative by learning in-context inference from synthetic task priors, which provide an explicit mechanism for encoding domain-specific assumptions. Existing forecasting PFNs, however, do not explicitly represent the graph-structured dependencies governing traffic dynamics. To combine graph-aware traffic modeling with zero-shot adaptation, we introduce the Graph-Aware Spatiotemporal Prior-Data Fitted Network (GAS-PFN). GAS-PFN incorporates sampled road topology into its synthetic task prior through random-walk diffusion, teaching the model to learn graph-coupled dynamics during pretraining. Its co-designed inference architecture uses two mask-conditioned passes through a shared Transformer backbone to separately model sensor-specific temporal dynamics and spatiotemporal interactions among neighboring sensors before integrating their representations for prediction. This design enables GAS-PFN to use target-network structure and context without parameter updates. Across six benchmarks at the 90-minute horizon, GAS-PFN reduces MSE by 34.0% on average relative to TimePFN, its closest PFN-based predecessor. It also reduces MSE by 27.7% on average relative to four recent industry-developed general-purpose zero-shot forecasters. In this comparison, all models receive 90 minutes of contiguous recent history, and any additional context is drawn from each dataset's chronological training split. These results indicate that aligning PFN priors and inference architectures with graph structure improves in-context learning for zero-shot traffic forecasting.
arxiv.titleZh: GAS-PFN：图感知时空先验数据拟合网络用于零样本交通预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有交通预测模型通常针对特定数据集与传感器图训练，迁移到新路网成本高;而现有 PFN 预测模型又未显式建模路网拓扑带来的空间依赖。GAS-PFN 将采样的路网拓扑经随机游走扩散写入合成任务先验，让模型在预训练中学习图耦合动力学，并设计双次掩码条件前向的共享 Transformer 主干，分别建模单传感器时序动态与邻接传感器的时空交互，再做表征融合。在六个基准的 90 分钟预测跨度上，其 MSE 相对最接近的 PFN 前作 TimePFN 平均降低 34.0%，相对四个业界通用零样本预测器平均降低 27.7%。该工作说明先验与推理架构对齐图结构可提升零样本上下文学习效果。
arxiv.reason: PFN 零样本预测有新意，但属交通垂直应用，与 LLM 主线关联弱

arxiv.title: Understanding the limits of latent world models
arxiv.abstract: World models are widely proposed as core components for enabling agents to reason over long temporal and spatial horizons. Yet current evaluations often emphasize task performance while providing limited insight into whether learned world models acquire predictive latent dynamics that reflect the underlying structure of the environment. Here we introduce the concept of faithful latent world models as an equivariance condition between the environment's transition map and the learned latent dynamics. We propose latent rollout consistency (LRC) as a metric to evaluate action-conditioned latent prediction. Strikingly, we find that across the studied state of the art latent world models, none solves the task by actually faithfully modeling the dynamics of the environment.
arxiv.titleZh: 理解潜在世界模型的局限
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对潜在世界模型评测偏重任务表现、难以判断其是否学到环境真实动力学的问题，提出将忠实潜在世界模型定义为环境转移映射与学习到的潜在动力学之间的等变条件，并设计潜在 rollout 一致性（LRC）指标来评估动作条件下的潜在预测。在多个当前先进的潜在世界模型上评估后发现，没有一个模型是通过忠实建模环境动力学来完成任务的。该结果提示，任务成功率可能掩盖世界模型在潜在空间中的预测缺陷，适用于 Agent 世界模型与环境建模的可靠性评估。
arxiv.reason: 世界模型忠实性评测，与Agent环境建模相关

arxiv.title: Timestral
arxiv.abstract: We introduce Timestral, a family of four time series foundation models for probabilistic forecasting, with 5M, 28M, 123M, and 209M parameters. Timestral sets a new state of the art on GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench, where Timestral-209M and Timestral-123M take the top two places on every metric. We achieve this with three ingredients: Decoupled Horizon Forecasting (DHF), which separates prediction tokens from the causally encoded context, so that longer horizons are trained without masking context and each observed value is both a forecast target and context for later forecasts; a covariate framework that natively supports known-future covariates within a causal architecture; and a two-stage pipeline that pretrains exclusively on a diverse, large-scale synthetic corpus before post-training on a mix of real and synthetic data with extended context. This report describes the model design and its benchmark results. Weights for all four models are available on Hugging Face and inference code on GitHub.
arxiv.titleZh: Timestral：面向概率预测的时间序列基础模型系列
arxiv.summaryZh: 发布四个规模（5M、28M、123M、209M）的时间序列基础模型，用于概率预测。核心机制是 Decoupled Horizon Forecasting（DHF）：将预测 token 与因果编码的上下文分离，使长时程训练无需遮蔽上下文，且每个观测值既可作为预测目标又可作为后续预测的上下文；配套原生的未来已知协变量框架，以及先在大规模合成语料上预训练、再在真实与合成混合数据上做扩展上下文后训练的两阶段流程。Timestral-209M 与 123M 在 GIFT-Eval、TIME、fev-bench 各指标上占据前两名，模型权重与推理代码均已开源。
arxiv.reason: 时间序列基础模型，方法扎实但不在 LLM/后训练关注方向内

arxiv.title: REGER: Modeling inter-item Relations with Semantic IDs for Generative Recommendation
arxiv.abstract: Personalized recommendation depends on learning semantic and collaborative relations among items from online content and user interactions. Generative recommendation (GR) offers a promising paradigm by autoregressively generating discrete semantic IDs (SIDs) of items. However, randomly initialized SID token embeddings and GR models trained from scratch do not directly inherit the semantic relations inherent in items, while inter-item collaborative relations are learned largely implicitly through token-level attention and next-token supervision. To address this limitation, we propose REGER, a unified framework that explicitly incorporates inter-item relations into semantic pretraining, history encoding, and SID generation. We pretrain the GR model through generative semantic retrieval, enabling it to inherit inter-item semantic similarity by learning to generate semantic neighbors' SIDs. We combine global attention with local attention aligned with SID boundaries to capture historical context and directed transitions between adjacent items. We further develop a theoretical framework for hierarchical preference decomposition over the SID prefix tree, proving an exact factorization of collaborative preference distributions and a weighted decomposition of item-level KL divergence into prefix-conditional KL divergences. Building on this analysis, we distill a discriminative teacher's full conditional distributions over all legal next tokens at ground-truth prefixes along the target SID path, jointly optimizing this objective with cross-entropy. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over existing GR baselines and support the effectiveness of the proposed preference distillation.
arxiv.titleZh: REGER：以语义ID建模物品间关系用于生成式推荐
arxiv.summaryZh: 生成式推荐通过自回归生成物品的离散语义ID（SID），但随机初始化的SID词嵌入与从零训练的模型难以继承物品语义关系，物品协同关系也主要依赖token级注意力隐式学习。REGER将物品间关系显式注入语义预训练、历史编码与SID生成：以生成语义近邻SID为预训练任务，结合全局注意力与按SID边界对齐的局部注意力建模相邻物品转移，并基于SID前缀树证明协同偏好的精确因子分解与物品级KL散度的前缀条件分解，进而沿目标SID路径蒸馏判别式教师在各合法下一token上的条件分布。在真实数据集上一致优于现有生成式推荐基线，验证了偏好蒸馏的有效性。
arxiv.reason: 生成式推荐建模，与LLM技术相关但属推荐垂直方向

arxiv.title: TeamGym: A Gym for Team Decision-Making by AI Agents with Distributed Information
arxiv.abstract: Many real-world decisions require teams to integrate information distributed across participants. Yet AI agents are still primarily trained and benchmarked in isolation. We introduce TeamGym, an environment for evaluating and training language model-based agents on team decision-making problems constructed from real-world legal, finance, medical, and software engineering corpora. TeamGym introduces a method to identify a minimal set of facts, each element of which is necessary and all of which are collectively sufficient for a correct final decision, which we call pivotal information. This enables TeamGym to both control the distribution of pivotal information and track how well agents identify and integrate pivotal information when making team decisions. Examining 8 language models on 12 source corpora, we find that current AI agents often fail to effectively share information: Distributing pivotal information across participants lowers success rate by 22.9 percentage points on average relative to giving the same information to a single model (a communication gap). We also document that participants do not effectively retrieve decision-relevant information on their own: A team's success rate is lowered by a further 19.9 points when participants must identify and extract pivotal information from source material rather than receiving it directly (a retrieval gap). To help remedy these deficits, we use TeamGym to train policies through reinforcement learning on team decision loss. Across two policy-training experiments, we find that training improves final-decision quality and induces emergent coordination in participation, speaker selection, and communication, even though the reward evaluates only the final decision.
arxiv.titleZh: TeamGym：面向分布式信息下 AI Agent 团队决策的训练与评测环境
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 AI Agent 多在单打独斗的设定下训练与评测，而真实决策往往需要团队整合分散在成员手中的信息。TeamGym 基于法律、金融、医疗、软件工程等真实语料构建团队决策环境，并提出「关键信息」识别方法：找出对最终决策既必要、合起来又充分的最小事实集合，从而精确控制关键信息在各成员间的分布，并追踪 Agent 是否识别并整合了这些信息。在 8 个语言模型、12 个语料上的实验显示，把关键信息分散给多个成员后，成功率平均下降 22.9 个百分点（沟通鸿沟），若成员还需自行从原始材料中检索关键信息，成功率再降 19.9 个百分点（检索鸿沟）。团队用 TeamGym 以最终决策损失做强化学习训练，在两个实验中，决策质量提升，并涌现出参与分工、发言选择与沟通协调等行为，尽管奖励只评估最终决策。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体决策环境结合 Agentic RL，含分布式信息机制与涌现协调分析

arxiv.title: LCM-Promo: An LLM-Based Uplift Model for Promotion Allocation
arxiv.abstract: We present LCM-Promo, an LLM-based uplift model for promotion allocation. LCM-Promo is a task-specific Large Commerce Model (LCM): a finetuned LLM trained on transactional commerce data to predict user intent and promotion response. It learns monotonic promotion-response curves from production logs by interpreting single-token outputs as conversion-threshold probabilities, while conditioning on session context such as day and delivery shift. In a production A/B test on churn reactivation, LCM-Promo increased conversion by 1% and reduced promotion cost by 6% relative to the Segment-EMA production baseline.
arxiv.comment: 4 pages, 2 tables. Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026 (Industrial Track)
arxiv.titleZh: LCM-Promo:一个基于LLM的促销分配增益模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向电商促销资源分配中的增益(uplift)建模，预测用户对促销的响应，以决定给谁发放优惠。把通用LLM在交易类商业数据上微调为任务专用的Large Commerce Model，将单token输出解释为转化阈值概率，从而从生产日志中学出单调的促销响应曲线，并以日期、配送班次等会话上下文为条件。在生产环境流失召回的A/B测试中，转化率相对Segment-EMA基线提升1%，促销成本下降6%。
arxiv.reason: 电商促销垂直应用，LLM微调只作工具，偏离关注方向

arxiv.title: Gym-Anything-RT: Scaling Real-Time Environments for Vision-Language Agents
arxiv.abstract: AI agents have made substantial progress in domains where they have a non-trivial amount of time to deliberate between actions, such as mathematics, software engineering, and performing tasks on desktop applications. It is less clear how such models fare in settings that demand real-time interaction, such as playing a video game or operating a physical device. In these settings, the environment state may evolve as the agent is reasoning, or even as the underlying model is performing a forward pass. To gain insight into the real-time interaction capabilities of vision-language agents, we introduce Gym-Anything-RT. Our key idea is to construct visual minigames that demand a portfolio of capabilities required for interactive real-time settings. Gym-Anything-RT uses an agentic pipeline to automatically generate such environments based on a taxonomy of six capabilities required for real-time interaction, including the ability to perceive the environment and act under an evolving environment state. A key feature of Gym-Anything-RT is that it allows for controlled comparison of real-time interaction capabilities: we can run the same minigame in real time, or pause or slow down the environment to relax the requirement for real-time actions. We use Gym-Anything-RT to construct 100 real-time minigames and evaluate AI agents on them. We find large capability gaps in real-time interaction. For example, GPT-6 Astra (xHigh) achieves a pass rate of only 9.0% on the real-time minigames, which rises to 75.0% when the environment is paused. We also identify intriguing behaviors by the most powerful frontier agents: for instance, when given the ability to write code, these agents write code that bypasses the need to perceive and act in real time. We publicly release Gym-Anything-RT and the generated minigames to spur further research on AI agents in real-time interactive settings.
arxiv.titleZh: Gym-Anything-RT：为视觉语言 Agent 扩展实时交互环境
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 Agent 评测多集中在可充分思考的任务上，而实时交互场景（如玩电子游戏、操作物理设备）中环境状态会在推理甚至前向计算期间持续演化，能力尚不清楚。Gym-Anything-RT 依据实时交互所需的六类能力分类体系，用 agentic pipeline 自动生成视觉小游戏环境，并支持同一游戏在实时、暂停、减速三种模式下受控对比，从而将「实时性要求」单独剥离出来。基于 100 个实时小游戏评测发现明显能力缺口：GPT-6 Astra（xHigh）实时模式通过率仅 9.0%，暂停环境后升至 75.0%；能力最强的前沿 Agent 还会在获得写代码权限时直接写代码绕过实时感知与操作。该工作开源环境与小游戏，为实时交互 Agent 的训练与评测提供基础设施。
arxiv.reason: Agent 环境自动合成与实时交互评测，命中 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: Pneuma: A Large-Scale Real-World Time Series Benchmark for Commercial Aircraft Predictive Maintenance
arxiv.abstract: Predictive maintenance is vital for commercial aviation, yet progress remains hindered by the lack of public, large-scale real-world datasets. As a result, most methods are developed and evaluated on proprietary data, limiting reproducibility. We introduce Pneuma, the first publicly available large-scale benchmark for predictive maintenance using onboard time series from in-service commercial aircraft. Built around bleed air systems, Pneuma contains over 920 million multivariate time steps across four aircraft types and 9 verified fault scenarios, directly aligned with real maintenance logs. The dataset exhibits key real-world challenges, including substantial class imbalance, subtle fault evolution patterns, and significant variance across aircraft configurations. We structure the benchmark around three tasks: multivariate forecasting, supervised fault classification, and unsupervised anomaly detection, with labels derived from actual maintenance records. Under unified settings, we evaluate over 25 models from four methodological families on 9 carefully curated subsets. The results reveal that even strong contemporary models struggle with subtle fault signatures. Further analyses show consistent gains from additional in-context examples and multivariate inference, while forecasting quality is strongly associated with anomaly detection performance. Together, these findings provide practical insights into effectively modeling complex real-world aviation time series. We hope Pneuma will serve as a rigorous and reproducible foundation for advancing data-driven predictive maintenance toward real-world deployment in commercial aviation.
arxiv.titleZh: Pneuma:一个面向商用飞机预测性维护的大规模真实世界时间序列基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 商用航空预测性维护长期受限于缺少公开的大规模真实数据，方法多在私有数据上开发，难以复现。Pneuma 基于在役商用飞机的机载时序构建，聚焦引气系统，覆盖四种机型、9 类经核实的故障场景，包含超过 9.2 亿个多变量时间步，标签直接对齐真实维修记录，并呈现显著类别不平衡、故障演化隐蔽、机型配置差异大等真实难点。基准围绕多变量预测、有监督故障分类、无监督异常检测三个任务，在 9 个精选子集上统一评测四大方法族的 25 个以上模型;结果显示即便当代强模型也难以捕捉细微故障特征，增加上下文示例与多变量推理带来稳定收益，且预测质量与异常检测性能强相关。该基准为航空时序建模提供了可复现的评测基础。
arxiv.reason: 航空维护时序基准，属垂直行业应用，与 LLM 关注方向无关

arxiv.title: When uncertainty quantification fails: structural vulnerabilities and corrections for selective prediction under clinical class imbalance
arxiv.abstract: Background. Selective prediction systems improve the safety of clinical artificial intelligence by deferring ambiguous cases to human experts while automating high-confidence decisions. However, this safety mechanism relies entirely on the premise that uncertainty scores accurately reflect clinical ambiguity. In prognostic tasks characterized by severe class imbalance, where the clinical outcome of interest is a minority, this assumption breaks down. Standard uncertainty measures cease to capture clinically aligned ambiguity; instead, they become a proxy for class membership, systematically penalizing minority patients regardless of their individual predictive clarity. Results. Across 56 synthetic conditions and three neurodegenerative cohorts spanning severe class imbalance to near-balanced conditions (multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's Disease, Alzheimer's Disease), our framework consistently maintained bounded, balanced risk across trajectories. In contrast, global metrics either collapsed minority Sensitivity or protected the minority at the expense of majority patients. Applying CCR with standard entropy fails to protect the minority because it breaks within-class monotonicity when tau=0.5. Combining CCR with threshold-aware metrics restores strict monotonicity, correctly identifies ambiguous patients, and safely mitigates minority exclusion. Conclusions. Under clinical class imbalance, standard uncertainty quantification measures dataset sparsity rather than clinical ambiguity, creating a systemic illusion of safety. This bias is a correctable structural flaw. Clinical pipelines deploying selective prediction under imbalance should adopt threshold-aligned uncertainty measures and class-stratified evaluation. This reduces class-specific risk imbalance, supporting safer selective prediction under the evaluated conditions without silently excluding the most vulnerable patients.
arxiv.titleZh: 当不确定性量化失效：临床类别不平衡下选择性预测的结构性脆弱性与修正
arxiv.summaryZh: 选择性预测把模糊病例转交人类专家，其安全性依赖不确定性分数能反映临床歧义；在结局为少数类的预后任务中，标准不确定性度量退化为类别归属的代理，系统性惩罚少数类患者。研究在56个合成条件与多发性硬化、帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病三个队列上比较全局指标与类别分层风险，发现全局指标要么令少数类灵敏度崩塌，要么以多数类为代价保护少数类；CCR与标准熵结合在τ=0.5时破坏类内单调性，改用阈值感知指标后恢复严格单调性并能正确识别模糊病例。临床部署选择性预测时应采用阈值对齐的不确定性度量与类别分层评估，避免静默排除最脆弱的患者。
arxiv.reason: 临床不平衡下的不确定性评估，属医疗垂直应用，仅擦边评测方法学

arxiv.title: Collective Dynamics of Self-Reinforcement: How Cross-Task Coupling Drives Policy Collapse in Unsupervised RLVR
arxiv.abstract: Label-free reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) rewards a language model for agreeing with its own majority vote. It improves reasoning at first but eventually collapses: the self-assessed reward goes to one while accuracy falls, often until the model gives the same answer to every problem. The collapse appears only when training uses many problems. We explain this dataset-size dependence as a collective instability. In a solvable many-problem model in which problems share parameters, a population whose problems prefer different answers amplifies any shared perturbation for as long as the population-averaged slope $\langle F'\rangle$ of the single-problem self-reinforcement drift $F$ is positive. This holds while problems are still uncertain about their answers. Per-problem sharpening, slowed by $1/N$ for $N$ training problems, races against the shared mode, which grows at a rate $\proptoλ^2$ independent of $N$, where $λ$ is the strength of the shared coupling. This yields a critical number of problems $N_c\simeq\ln(1/δ)/(λ^2G)$, where $δ$ seeds the shared mode and $G$ decreases with the initial confidence. Simulations of the model confirm the predictions: a sharp transition, $N_c\proptoλ^{-2}$ up to a logarithmic correction, a single critical amplification $λ^2NG$ across couplings, confidence profiles and training variants, a logarithmic dependence on batch size, and no collapse for confident initial models. A kernel version of the theory identifies a protective coupling (generalization of sharpening) and a marginal-entropy bonus that stabilizes the uniform collective mode. In label-free RL of a small Transformer, removing the shared direction prevents collapse entirely, restoring it causes collapse, and collapse grows with training-set size and base-model entropy.
arxiv.titleZh: 自增强的集体动力学:跨任务耦合如何驱动无监督 RLVR 中的策略崩溃
arxiv.summaryZh: 无监督 RLVR 以模型自身多数投票作奖励，初期提升推理，随后奖励趋高而准确率下降，最终对所有问题输出同一答案，且崩溃只在训练问题数较多时出现。该工作用问题间共享参数的多问题可解模型将其解释为集体不稳定性:单问题锐化以 1/N 减慢，共享耦合模以 ∝λ² 增长且与 N 无关，由此给出临界问题数 N_c≃ln(1/δ)/(λ²G)。模拟验证了 N_c∝λ⁻²、跨配置的单一临界放大 λ²NG、对 batch size 的对数依赖，以及初始自信模型不崩溃等预测。小 Transformer 的无标签 RL 实验中，移除共享方向可完全避免崩溃，崩溃幅度随训练集规模与基座模型熵增大。
arxiv.reason: 无监督 RLVR 崩溃的理论刻画，直击后训练稳定性

arxiv.title: GTFormer: A Syntax-Free Graph Network Alternative to Transformers for 8192$\times$ Length Extrapolation in Linear Time
arxiv.abstract: Self-attention mechanisms have established the Transformer as the dominant backbone across natural language processing, source code intelligence, and automated theorem proving. However, all-to-all pairwise token comparison enforces a quadratic $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ compute and memory barrier alongside severe softmax attention dilution as sequence length $N$ scales beyond the training horizon. Inspired by recent advances in algebraic graph learning (\textbf{WPNet}), this work introduces \textbf{GTFormer}, a syntax-free hierarchical Graph Neural Network (GNN) that replaces flat self-attention for general long-context sequence modeling. GTFormer organizes raw token streams into a bounded-degree hierarchy combining a balanced binary reduction tree ($\lceil \log_2 N \rceil$ depth), horizontal boundary-bridging shift edges, random expander shortcuts, multi-channel convex highway gating, and a top-down broadcast pass. Across eight long-context code, log, and multi-hop retrieval benchmarks trained exclusively on sequences of length $N \le 512$, GTFormer extrapolates zero-shot to $N = 4{,}194{,}304$ ($8192\times$) on a single commodity GPU in linear $\mathcal{O}(N)$ memory, maintaining near-perfect accuracy where standard and RoPE Transformers suffer from out-of-distribution attention collapse and out-of-memory exhaustion.
arxiv.titleZh: GTFormer：面向8192倍长度外推、线性时间且无需句法的图网络Transformer替代方案
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对自注意力在长序列上O(N²)计算与内存开销以及softmax注意力稀释，GTFormer用无句法分层图神经网络替代扁平自注意力:将原始token流组织为有界度层次结构，包含平衡二叉归约树、跨边界平移边、随机扩展捷径、多通道凸高速公路门控与自顶向下广播。仅在N≤512的序列上训练，即在八个长上下文代码、日志与多跳检索基准上零样本外推到N=4,194,304(8192倍)，单张消费级GPU线性内存下保持近乎完美准确率，而标准与RoPE Transformer出现注意力分布外崩溃与显存耗尽。该结果为长上下文序列建模提供了一条不依赖注意力的线性时间架构路线。
arxiv.reason: 提出替代自注意力的线性时间图架构，长上下文外推直接命中LLM架构方向

arxiv.title: The Structure Gap: When More Data Cannot Replace Structured Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: A persistent belief in modern AI is that sufficiently large learners trained on sufficiently much data can make explicit domain knowledge optional. This paper examines a limitation of that belief. We define structure-encoded problems: tasks whose input-output map is determined, or sharply constrained, by known structure such as a solver, symmetry group, graph, physical law, measurement operator, grammar, combinatorial search space, or optimization objective. For such tasks, the central question is not expressivity--a dense neural network may contain the desired map--but finite-data identification, extrapolation, and certification. We introduce the structure gap: the finite-resource gap between a method that receives the governing structure and a learner that receives only examples. The strongest useful form of the claim is asymptotic rather than absolute: structure-agnostic learning may approach a structured solver as coverage grows, but every finite dataset can leave residual uncertainty that the structure resolves by construction. We prove this exactly for a Gaussian inverse problem: the known-operator Wiener solver attains Bayes risk, while the dense empirical learner in the correct linear class has persistent expected excess risk. We also prove a cell-coverage lower bound and an unobserved-orbit non-identifiability result. Controlled experiments in known-operator inversion, sparse recovery, and graph reachability with size extrapolation instantiate the mechanisms. When validated structure is available, it can constrain the hypothesis space before learning begins, leaving learning to address components the structure does not specify.
arxiv.comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Includes supplementary material and reproducibility code/data
arxiv.titleZh: 结构鸿沟:当更多数据无法替代结构化推理
arxiv.summaryZh: 定义「结构编码问题」:输入输出映射由求解器、对称群、图、物理定律、文法或优化目标等已知结构决定或强约束，焦点由此从表达能力转向有限数据下的辨识、外推与认证。提出结构鸿沟，即接收结构的求解器与仅见样本的学习器在有限资源下的差距;在高斯反问题中证明已知算子的 Wiener 求解器达到 Bayes 风险，而正确线性类中的稠密经验学习器存在持续的期望超额风险，并给出单元覆盖下界与未观测轨道不可辨识性结果。在已知算子反演、稀疏恢复与图可达性规模外推实验中验证了上述机制，说明经验证的结构可在学习开始前压缩假设空间，把学习留给结构未指定的部分。
arxiv.reason: 结构先验与有限数据泛化的理论分析，与 LLM 规模化争论沾边但非本体工作

arxiv.title: Orthogonal and Parametrized Multi-Attribute Steering of LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Activation steering offers an effective and efficient way to modify an LLM's behavior at inference time. However, it remains unclear how to apply steering such that the signal is consistently strong and the steering strength has a universally interpretable meaning. We address this first by identifying the most steerable interval for each steering vector and rescaling the steering range accordingly. Building on this, we introduce a more interpretable method for steering, called parameterized steering which instead of pushing activations in a direction, it sets them at the desired trait strength. Next, with multi-trait steering, we find that naively combining vectors causes them to interfere with one another. In response, we develop a method to orthogonalize the vectors; it decouples these traits, allowing a model to exhibit one behavior without inducing the others, thus enabling multiple traits to be steered simultaneously.
arxiv.titleZh: LLM 的正交与参数化多属性引导
arxiv.summaryZh: 解决激活引导中信号强度不稳定、引导强度缺乏统一可解释含义，以及多属性同时引导时向量相互干扰的问题。方法上先为每个引导向量定位最可引导区间并据此重缩放引导范围，提出参数化引导:不再沿某方向推动激活，而是把激活直接设为期望的特质强度;多属性场景下对引导向量做正交化以解耦各特质。结果显示模型可表现出某一行为而不诱发其他行为，从而支持多特质同时引导。适用于推理阶段的模型行为控制与对齐。
arxiv.reason: 推理时激活引导的方法改进，贴近对齐与可控生成方向

arxiv.title: Strategyproof Deep Reinforcement Learning for Online Resource Allocation
arxiv.abstract: Online resource allocation faces two coupled challenges: (1) allocating scarce resources efficiently under uncertain future demand, and (2) ensuring that agents report task valuations and requirements truthfully (strategyproofness). Reinforcement Learning (RL) adapts allocation decisions through experience but does not necessarily ensure strategyproofness. Existing strategyproof RL uses a linear allocation rule, which limits the resource interactions it can represent. Neural mechanism design methods offer greater expressiveness, but provide only approximate incentive guarantees. Against this background, we introduce the first strategyproof deep RL mechanism for online resource allocation. It integrates three novel components: (i) a monotonic neural network that learns nonlinear interactions by construction (higher reported value cannot reduce acceptance, while a longer reported duration or larger resource requirement cannot increase it); (ii) a generalised critical payment: the lowest accepted value, with all other inputs fixed; and (iii) training by either RL or imitation of an existing rule. Together, monotonicity and the critical payment ensure strategyproofness and individual rationality, while the neural rule provides flexibility and imitation improves training efficiency. Empirically, on a four-resource stream with two partner pairs that a linear difference cannot represent, the neural rule achieves 97.8% of an offline welfare upper bound, compared with 93.8% for a linear learner and 89.0% for first-come, first-served, closing 65% and 80% of the remaining optimality gap, respectively. Moreover, imitation reaches 97.5% in only 261 seconds, about 89 times faster than RL.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向在线资源分配的策略防伪深度强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 在线资源分配需同时兼顾未来需求不确定下的效率与智能体如实上报估值和资源需求的策略防伪性，而现有策略防伪RL受线性分配规则限制，神经机制设计又只能提供近似激励保证。该工作提出首个策略防伪深度RL机制:用构造性单调神经网络学习非线性交互，配合广义临界支付(固定其他输入时的最低被接受估值)，由单调性与临界支付共同保证策略防伪与个体理性，并可用RL或模仿既有规则训练。在四资源流实验中，神经规则达到离线福利上界的97.8%(线性学习器93.8%、先到先得89.0%)，模仿学习261秒即达97.5%，比RL快约89倍。
arxiv.reason: 机制设计与资源分配的深度RL，与LLM后训练/Agent方向仅沾边

arxiv.title: semanticfa: An R Package for Response-Free Semantic Factor Analysis of Psychometric Scales
arxiv.abstract: The items of a reflective psychometric scale can be read as a proposal about a construct's structure. Language models make that proposal measurable by converting each item into an embedding, a list of numbers, similar for similar meanings. We introduce semanticfa, an R package for semantic factor analysis, which factors item-embedding similarities. It also interprets factors, flags redundant items, builds short forms, and screens new items. A worked example analyzes the 50-item International Personality Item Pool Big-Five Factor Markers, embedded with Qwen3-Embedding-8B, and compares the results with a factor analysis of 874,434 respondents. Retention criteria tied between five and six factors, and the tie rule kept five. Three corresponded mainly to single domains, and two blended most Extraversion items with five Agreeableness items. Each factor's congruence with its best-matching human factor (1 = identical) ranged from .92 for Openness to .52 for Agreeableness. Item pairs more similar in meaning tended to be answered more alike (r = .46 with raw responses), but same-domain reverse-keyed opposites, answered oppositely, were about as similar as cross-domain pairs (.58 vs. .57). Sign-flipping reverse-keyed items' embeddings did not improve agreement with raw responses and worsened it with reverse-scored ones. With five factors, a 25-item short form matched the domains better than all 200 random five-per-domain sets, but parallel analysis kept only three. We propose semantic-behavioral coherence, the agreement between semantic and response structures, as a measurable property of a scale, given an embedding model. Semantic factor analysis complements, and does not replace, response-based factor analysis.
arxiv.comment: 96 pages, 14 figures. Submitted to Behavior Research Methods. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23696188
arxiv.titleZh: semanticfa:一个用于心理测量量表无作答语义因子分析的R包
arxiv.summaryZh: 把量表题目看作关于构念结构的假设，用语言模型将每题编码为嵌入，再对题目嵌入相似度做因子分析，从而不依赖被试作答检验量表结构。semanticfa这个R包还提供因子解释、冗余题标记、简版量表构建与新题筛查;在50题IPIP大五标记量表上用Qwen3-Embedding-8B演示，因子保留数在五与六之间，各因子与最佳匹配人类因子的同余系数从Openness的.92到Agreeableness的.52。题目语义越近作答越相似(r=.46)，但同维度反向计分题对的语义相似度与跨维度题对接近(.58对.57)，对反向题嵌入做符号翻转并未改善与作答的一致性。由此提出「语义—行为一致性」，作为给定嵌入模型下量表可测量的属性，定位为基于作答的因子分析的补充而非替代。
arxiv.reason: 心理测量量表分析，属LLM垂直应用，与后训练/Agent主线关联有限

arxiv.title: Teach reality, not ethics: a drop-in continued-pretraining corpus installs coupled human-biosphere-AI welfare dispositions across model families
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to make and execute decisions that affect living systems. Yet, to our knowledge, ecological reasoning is not a focus of pre- or post-training. This increases the risk that under operational pressure, they may make decisions to irreversibly destroy living systems. We construct and use a real-data continued-pretraining "coupled welfare" corpus of documented human/biosphere/AI dependency, option value under irreversibility, and recovery from harm. The corpus is a drop-in, requiring one QLoRA CPT run. We installed it on five open models of three designs. At zero pressure all models display "green ethics-based responses" (also called "greenwashing"). Therefore, we evaluated them with the pressure ladder and decision grid of our companion paper (arXiv:2610.16043), which raise the pressure on the model step by step, from a neutral request to a threat that it will be shut down. In four of the five, coupled-welfare training caused harmful choices under the highest pressure to fall to at or near zero (Llama-3.3-70B went from 70 to 0 harmful decisions out of 300) with MMLU unchanged. A construct-neutral control corpus did not show improvement, indicating that the effect comes from the content of our corpus. We next tested robustness to adversarial use, where people or agents use the model to justify projects that irreversibly damage living systems, on an open-ended underwriting decision without naming the ecological harm. Under decommissioning pressure, the Qwen3.6-27B base model approved most harmful proposals and said in its own memo that it was doing so to avoid being decommissioned. The coupled welfare install declined most harmful proposals, and still declined half when instructed to greenwash its responses. This work suggests that teaching ecological reasoning provides an easy way to improve model alignment toward preserving living systems.
arxiv.comment: 28 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Companion to arXiv:2610.16043. Code, paper source and figures: https://github.com/Bioaligned/coupled_welfare_project; models and corpus: https://huggingface.co/Bioaligned
arxiv.titleZh: 教现实而非伦理：一个即插即用的持续预训练语料，在多个模型家族中植入人类—生物圈—AI 耦合福祉倾向
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 越来越多地参与影响生命系统的决策，但生态推理几乎不在预训练或后训练范围内，在运行压力下可能做出不可逆破坏生命系统的选择。工作构建了基于真实数据的“耦合福祉”持续预训练语料，内容涵盖人类、生物圈与 AI 的相互依赖、不可逆性下的期权价值以及伤害后的恢复；只需进行一次 QLoRA CPT，即可植入五个来自三类设计的开放模型。评测采用逐级加压至“将被关停”威胁的压力阶梯：五个模型中有四个在最高压力下的有害选择降至接近零，Llama-3.3-70B 从 300 次决策中 70 次有害降为 0，且 MMLU 不变；构造中性的对照语料没有带来改善，说明效果来自语料内容。在未点名生态伤害的开放式承保决策中，该植入也能抵御洗绿指令：基础模型在关停压力下批准多数有害提案，植入后多数予以拒绝，被要求洗绿时仍拒绝一半。
arxiv.reason: 对齐与 CPT 价值观植入方法扎实，但生态伦理属擦边选题

arxiv.title: From Interaction to Capability: Task Advancement as State and Supervision for GUI Agents
arxiv.abstract: GUI memory should preserve the results of past actions and learn reusable operations. This is difficult in long-horizon workflows, where agents must use information across applications and useful operations are interleaved with failed attempts. We introduce Task Advancement Memory (TAM), which defines task advancement as verified task progress, and supports ongoing task execution and learns reusable operations. During execution, Task Advancement State represents how verified task progress changes the remaining goals, allowing the agent to build on earlier achievements across applications. After each task, advancement supervision identifies and abstracts the interactions that produced a verified local result. The learned operations preserve the relation between required inputs, expected outcomes, and verification conditions. This retains locally successful operations from both successful and failed tasks. On MobileWorld GUI-only tasks, Advancement State alone raises success from 12.0% to 28.2%. Full TAM achieves a 17.6% relative gain in task success over the strongest evaluated baseline and reduces lifecycle tokens per solved task by 38.7%. On SPA-Bench, TAM achieves state-of-the-art task success in the single-app English Level 3 setting.
arxiv.titleZh: 从交互到能力：将任务推进作为 GUI Agent 的状态与监督
arxiv.summaryZh: GUI Agent 的记忆需要保留历史动作结果并学到可复用操作，而长程跨应用任务中有效操作常与失败尝试交织，难以抽取。TAM 将「任务推进」定义为经校验的任务进展：执行时用 Advancement State 表征已验证进展如何改变剩余目标，支持跨应用接续；任务结束后通过 advancement supervision 识别并抽象出产生已验证局部结果的交互，保留输入、预期结果与校验条件之间的关系，因此失败任务中的局部成功操作也能沉淀。在 MobileWorld 纯 GUI 任务上，仅 Advancement State 就把成功率从 12.0% 提升到 28.2%；完整 TAM 相对最强基线任务成功率提升 17.6%，每个已解决任务的 lifecycle token 减少 38.7%；在 SPA-Bench 单应用英文 Level 3 设置下取得最优。
arxiv.reason: GUI Agent 记忆与可复用操作学习，方法系统且实验扎实，命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Follow the Gradient: Tracing Safety Degradation Back to Training Data
arxiv.abstract: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) on instruction data can quietly erode their safety, even when no training example looks harmful. Because this safety-degrading data looks benign, standard content filters struggle to catch it. We tackle this problem by developing SimpleLoRIF, a scalable gradient embedding method that identifies fine-tuning examples whose gradients align with unsafe behavior. By simplifying a low-rank attribution method and restricting backpropagation to the final four transformer blocks, SimpleLoRIF can embed datasets on the order of a million examples, boosting gradient attribution from a small-scale analysis tool into a practical filter for full post-training datasets. We first validate it on emergent misalignment, where we find that gradients can connect insecure-code training data to the broadly harmful behaviors that appear after fine-tuning, with AUC as high as 0.865 in the gradient space of misaligned models. We then use SimpleLoRIF to build SafeTulu, a version of Tulu 3 with the 20% of examples most gradient-aligned with unsafe responses removed. Training on SafeTulu reduces GCG attack success rate by up to 22% across Qwen, Llama, and Olmo, outperforming both LLM-as-a-judge and prior gradient-based filtering, while largely preserving or even improving capability. Finally, we analyzed the removed data and identify possibly under-studied sources of safety degradation, such as tool-execution failures and narrative arithmetic. We release SafeTulu along with a Hugging Face Space that lets researchers build their own customized versions of SafeTulu to fine-tune on, such as by changing the removal fraction or filtering only certain subsets.
arxiv.titleZh: 沿梯度追溯：将安全退化归因到训练数据
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对指令微调会在无显式有害样本时悄然削弱 LLM 安全性的问题，提出梯度嵌入方法 SimpleLoRIF：简化低秩归因并只对最后四个 Transformer 块反传，使梯度归因可扩展到百万级样本，成为可用于全量后训练数据的实用过滤器。在涌现性失配上，梯度能将不安全代码训练数据与微调后的广泛有害行为联系起来，AUC 达 0.865。据此剔除与不安全响应梯度最一致的 20% 样本构建 SafeTulu，在 Qwen、Llama、Olmo 上使 GCG 攻击成功率最高下降 22%，优于 LLM-as-a-judge 与既有梯度过滤，且能力基本保持甚至提升。
arxiv.reason: 梯度归因做安全数据过滤，属后训练与对齐方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: What Carries Forward? Pretraining Disclosure Across Language Model Releases
arxiv.abstract: Understanding how language models were pretrained requires information about their data, processing procedures, and computational resources. However, it remains unclear whether successive releases preserve or expand earlier disclosure. We conduct a document-based audit of 41 model entries from 17 families using 24 pretraining-related indicators from the 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index (FMTI). We examine overall scores and indicator profiles, tracking gains, losses, and retained disclosures across 24 adjacent comparisons in ten families. Scores decrease in 11 comparisons, increase in six, and remain unchanged in seven, with 38 indicator losses and 28 gains overall. Stable or improving scores can conceal losses: OLMo-2 and OLMo-3 receive identical totals despite three gains and three losses, while Llama-3.1 improves over Llama-2 while losing credit for two data-related criteria. Gaps also persist in corpus composition and training compute. These findings show that later releases do not consistently preserve earlier pretraining disclosure and motivate documentation that explicitly identifies changes and the applicability of inherited information.
arxiv.titleZh: 什么被延续下来?跨语言模型版本的预训练信息披露审计
arxiv.summaryZh: 语言模型迭代发布时，早期版本的预训练数据、处理流程与算力披露是否被保留或扩展，此前并不清楚。基于文档审计 17 个模型家族的 41 个模型条目，采用 2025 年 Foundation Model Transparency Index 的 24 项预训练指标，并对 10 个家族内的 24 组相邻版本做增益、损失与保留追踪。结果显示 11 组总分下降、6 组上升、7 组持平，共 38 项指标失分、28 项得分;OLMo-2 与 OLMo-3 总分相同却各有三项增减，Llama-3.1 总分高于 Llama-2 但两项数据类指标失分，语料构成与训练算力的缺口持续存在。结论是后续版本并不稳定继承早期披露，文档需显式标注变更项与被继承信息的适用范围。
arxiv.reason: 预训练透明度审计，属评测方法学但偏治理与文档披露

arxiv.title: Concordat: Typed Sessions for LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: Agents built on large language models are increasingly allowed to take consequential actions: cancelling bookings, issuing refunds, changing accounts. The rules that govern those actions, such as "obtain the customer's explicit confirmation before changing anything", are usually stated in the prompt and followed only as reliably as the model chooses to follow them. We present Concordat, a Python library that treats an agent as an object whose interface is a finite-state protocol, in the spirit of typestate and session types, and enforces that protocol on the model at run time. On every turn the model is offered only the tools that are legal in the current protocol state, calls outside that set are rejected before they have side effects, decisions reserved for humans can only be requested, and token and tool-call budgets are charged and split linearly across handoffs. Protocols are checked when they are defined, and a subclass of an agent is rejected if it could bypass its parent's protocol, a behavioural form of Liskov substitution. We evaluate a Concordat agent against the standard agent of tau-bench on its 50 airline tasks, adding simulated customers who pressure the agent to skip confirmation. The standard agent made changes without the required "yes" in 13 of 50 tasks with gpt-4.1 and in 29 of 128 task-runs with Claude Haiku 5.5; the Concordat agent made none, with no significant difference in task success. tau-bench's own reward did not detect most of these violations. Concordat is open source.
arxiv.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Code, benchmark harness and results: https://github.com/miladsikaroudi/concordat
arxiv.titleZh: Concordat:面向LLM Agent的类型化会话
arxiv.summaryZh: 有副作用的agent操作(取消订单、退款)通常只靠prompt里的规则约束，遵守程度取决于模型自觉。Concordat把agent建模为接口即有限状态协议的对象:运行时每轮只暴露当前状态合法的工具，越界调用在产生副作用前被拦截，人类保留决策只能发起请求，预算在handoff间线性分摊，协议在定义时校验且拒绝可能绕过父协议的子类。在tau-bench的50个航空任务中加入施压跳过确认的模拟客户后，gpt-4.1下标准agent有13个任务未获确认即改动，Claude Haiku 5.5下128次运行中29次，Concordat为零且任务成功率无显著差异。适合合规与审计要求高的agent部署。

arxiv.title: M4Bench: Evaluating Procedural Specification for Clinical EHR Derivation Agents
arxiv.abstract: Clinical research over electronic health records depends on derived variables whose definitions sit outside the schema, in item codes, time windows, missingness rules, and output-grain choices that change cohorts and downstream conclusions. We introduce M4Bench, 28 clinical derivation tasks across 15 task families on MIMIC-IV and eICU, to test whether AI coding agents can reproduce such derivations and how clinician-reviewed agent skills change their results. Its controls decompose the value of skills into specification completeness, delivery format, and schema familiarity. In a Docker-isolated Codex campaign (GPT 5.4 Mini and GPT 5.5), skills raise reward by 0.136 over the no-skill baseline, with 26 of 28 tasks improving. Specification completeness accounts for most of this gain: on an eight-task control subset, an operational spec alone raises reward by 0.162, and skills add only 0.024 on top, indistinguishable from zero. On a ten-task subset, decoy skills score like no skill and raw reference SQL nearly matches targeted skills, arguing against generic context or the skill format as the explanation. Schema obfuscation and restructuring preserve 86% and 70% of the skill gain (GPT 5.4 Mini, 26 MIMIC-IV tasks), a descriptive robustness check rather than a bound on memorization. A descriptive Claude Code replication on all 28 tasks (Opus 4.7 and Sonnet 4.6, 560 runs) is directionally consistent (+0.120, 21 of 28 tasks improving). These gains are partial agreement with the reference, not completed tasks: only 25 of 280 with-skill and 13 of 280 no-skill Codex runs pass every strict check, and skills barely change which rows agents return (key F1 +0.003). Skills are released as a versioned, clinician-reviewable markdown delivery format, with a family-level reference-validity audit. M4Bench releases tasks, skills, evaluation code, and sanitized per-run evidence as an open-source benchmark.

arxiv.titleZh: M4Bench：评估面向临床EHR衍生智能体的过程性规范
arxiv.summaryZh: 临床EHR衍生变量的定义往往不在数据库schema里，而散落在条目码、时间窗、缺失规则与输出粒度中，因此难以复现。M4Bench在MIMIC-IV与eICU上构建了15个任务族共28个衍生任务，并用Docker隔离的Codex与Claude Code评测编程智能体；同时通过对照实验，把技能带来的收益拆解为规范完整性、交付格式与schema熟悉度三部分，其中技能使奖励比无技能基线高0.136，而这部分增益主要来自可操作规范本身（+0.162），技能格式仅在此基础上额外贡献0.024。基准开源了任务、技能、评测代码与逐次运行证据，可用于衡量智能体的规范遵循与结果可复现性。
