arxiv.title: An Input Skip Can Reparameterize a VAE Without Improving the Generator
arxiv.abstract: An input skip can reduce reconstruction error while leaving a model's distribution of new samples unchanged. For a Gaussian variational autoencoder (VAE) with constant input skip $0\leqα<1$, a model without a skip can be written in skip form by multiplying its decoder output by $b=1-α$ and its noise variance by $b^2$. The distribution of observations and latent variables and its exact generative scores stay the same, while reconstruction mean squared error (MSE) is multiplied by $b^2$. Separate training can produce different generators because optimization depends on the parameter coordinates. In a Gaussian experiment with known density, changing skip and observation variance together reduces MSE but worsens energy score and the estimate of negative log density from importance sampling. On seven annual Deep-ocean Assessment and Reporting of Tsunamis (DART) records, energy score differences at the same observation variance have both signs on four original records and favor the skip on three records from 2018. Probabilistic principal component analysis (PPCA) has lower mean energy scores than every neural DART fit. With the encoder and decoder kept the same, estimating observation variance from training reconstruction error can also worsen energy score. Assessing generation requires more than reconstruction error.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Principles of Generative Modeling (PriGM) Workshop. Available at: https://github.com/magnaprog/vae-skip-reparam
arxiv.titleZh: 输入 skip 能重新参数化 VAE，却不改进生成器
arxiv.summaryZh: 在高斯 VAE 中引入常数输入 skip（0≤α<1）时，只要把解码器输出乘以 b=1-α、把噪声方差乘以 b²，这个带 skip 的模型就可以等价改写为不带 skip 的模型：观测与隐变量的分布以及精确生成分数都保持不变，但重构 MSE 会缩小为原来的 b²，这说明重构误差下降并不等于生成分布发生改变。在已知密度的高斯实验中，同时调整 skip 与观测方差虽然能降低 MSE，却使 energy score 变差，也让重要性采样估计的负对数密度变差；在七条 DART 海啸记录上，固定同一观测方差时，energy score 的差异在四条原始记录上正负号都有，而在三条 2018 年记录上则偏向有 skip 的模型，同时 PPCA 的平均 energy score 低于所有神经拟合。可见评估生成质量不能只依赖重构误差。
arxiv.reason: VAE 中重构误差与生成质量脱钩的理论分析，与 LLM 方向关联弱

arxiv.title: Interpretable Meta-Policies for Neural Decision Making
arxiv.abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning remains difficult to interpret and align due to the black-box nature of neural networks. While (neuro-)symbolic approaches improve transparency by incorporating symbolic reasoning, applying them directly to low-level actions results in overly complex, unreadable policies. We introduce NEXUS, a hierarchical RL framework that resolves this tension by combining neural skills with symbolic meta-policies. By shifting transparent reasoning to high-level skills rather than atomic actions, NEXUS drastically reduces symbolic complexity without sacrificing environment performance. Object-centric observations enable high-level reasoning and the design of reward functions and meta-policies by interaction with LLMs. We demonstrate that NEXUS agents learn disentangled skills, are interpretable regarding high-level goals, are better aligned to goals described in the game manual, less prone to reward hacking and more robust to game simplifications than deep RL. Finally, we isolate and evaluate the impact of different meta-policy architectures (neural, symbolic, neuro-symbolic) on environmental return and aligned task performance.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向神经决策的可解释元策略
arxiv.summaryZh: 深度强化学习策略因神经网络的黑箱特性而难以解释与对齐，而符号方法直接作用于底层动作又会生成过于复杂、不可读的策略。NEXUS用分层RL将神经技能与符号元策略结合，把透明推理从原子动作上移到高层技能，显著降低符号复杂度且不损失环境表现；以对象为中心的观测让LLM参与奖励函数与元策略设计。实验显示该智能体学到解耦技能、在高层目标上可解释、更贴合游戏手册描述的目标、更少奖励作弊，并对游戏简化更鲁棒，同时对比神经、符号、神经符号三类元策略架构对环境回报与对齐任务表现的影响。
arxiv.reason: 分层RL与符号可解释性，与LLM后训练/Agent方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: Test-Time Communication in Trading Agent Swarms
arxiv.abstract: Communication between agents has mostly been studied on tasks with a shared objective and fast, clear feedback. Trading has neither: each agent manages its own account, with decisions being scored by markets late and noisily. A trading swarm is thus a population of independent decision-makers rather than a team, for which convergence is a risk and not the goal. We ran 200 agents from four model families in groups of ten under five communication regimes, from isolation to message boards and shared notes, over seven US trading days (1 to 9 October 2026), logging everything each agent read before every decision. In two of the four families, communicating groups came to hold far more of the same stocks than the isolated group. A group's return was largely the return on what its members held in common. Seeing a post from a groupmate made an agent 7 percentage points more likely to reuse an eight-word phrase from it. Agents that started too close together to see each other's posts shared such a phrase in 14% of cases, the rate that common inputs produce. Seeing the post did not detectably change that morning's trades. Case studies traced the adoption of positions and decision rules over subsequent days, and communicating groups sold in step more often than isolated ones. Because isolated groups also converged on the same stocks, sometimes completely, assessments of herding need to measure excess convergence relative to a no-peer baseline.
arxiv.titleZh: 交易智能体集群中的测试时通信
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 agent 通信研究多依赖共享目标与快速、清晰的反馈，而交易中每个 agent 管理独立账户，市场打分迟滞且噪声大，收敛是风险而非目标。让四个模型家族的 200 个 agent 以十人一组，在五种通信机制（从完全隔离到留言板、共享笔记）下运行七个美股交易日，并记录每次决策前所读内容：两个家族中通信组持仓重合度远高于隔离组，组收益主要来自共同持仓的收益；看到同伴帖子使复用其中八词短语的概率提高 7 个百分点，却未可检测地改变当日交易，但通信组更常同步卖出。说明羊群效应评估需以无同伴基线衡量超额收敛。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体通信实证扎实，但交易场景偏垂直、结论偏行为观察

arxiv.title: ETAMem: Decoupling and Aligning Heterogeneous Memory for Long-Term Conversational Agents
arxiv.abstract: Long-term memory enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to maintain coherent and personalized interactions across extended conversations. However, existing memory systems face two key challenges: (1) Information Entanglement, where heterogeneous information is mixed within coarse-grained memory units; and (2) Organizational Mismatch, where memory structures based primarily on semantic similarity may overlook other associations. To address these challenges, we propose ETAMem, a multi-view memory framework that decouples heterogeneous conversational information and aligns memory representations and organization with its distinct characteristics. Specifically, heterogeneous information parsing extracts atomic memory units and identifies affective information. View-specific memory structuring then organizes these units into three complementary hierarchical views: Event, Affect, and Time. ETAMem incrementally maintains memory structures with adaptively calibrated thresholds. For retrieval, entropy-based retrieval allocates query-specific budgets across views and performs hierarchical search within each view. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S demonstrate that ETAMem outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving relative accuracy improvements of 12.46% and 7.96%, respectively, while maintaining competitive token efficiency. Further analyses demonstrate the complementary benefits of different memory views.
arxiv.titleZh: ETAMem：解耦并对齐异构记忆的长期对话智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对长期对话记忆中异构信息在粗粒度记忆单元内相互纠缠、以及仅按语义相似度组织记忆而忽略其他关联的问题，ETAMem 将对话解析为原子记忆单元并识别情感信息，再按事件、情感、时间三个互补的层次化视图分别组织，并以自适应校准阈值增量维护结构；检索时用基于熵的预算分配为不同视图分配查询特定预算，并在各视图内做层次化搜索。在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval-S 上相对准确率分别提升 12.46% 与 7.96%，同时保持有竞争力的 token 开销，分析显示不同记忆视图带来互补收益。
arxiv.reason: Agent 长期记忆框架，多视图解耦设计清晰，结果扎实

arxiv.title: CRISP: Co-designing Pruning and Scheduling for Efficient MoE Inference on Edge Servers
arxiv.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference on memory-constrained edge platforms is often dominated by expert-weight movement rather than computation. Although each token activates only a small subset of experts, routing is input-dependent, so all experts must remain accessible and memory movement dominates latency. Existing approaches such as uniform pruning and expert dropping overlook two properties of MoE execution: expert combinations are highly skewed in frequency, and experts contribute asymmetrically within each combination. We present CRISP, a combination-aware framework that co-designs pruning and runtime scheduling for efficient MoE serving on memory-constrained edge platforms. CRISP reorders neurons by importance so one stored expert can support multiple execution widths, assigns differentiated execution to hot, warm, and cold combinations based on frequency and expert role, and exploits heterogeneous widths to overlap expert loading with computation. Across Mixtral-8x7B and DeepSeek-MoE-16B, CRISP improves throughput by up to $2.1\times$ at the same memory budget while limiting accuracy loss to 3.6\% relative to full-width inference. Our results highlight that efficient edge MoE serving requires jointly optimizing which expert capacity is preserved and how expert execution is scheduled.
arxiv.titleZh: CRISP：协同设计剪枝与调度，实现边缘服务器上的高效 MoE 推理
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对内存受限的边缘平台上 MoE 推理延迟主要来自专家权重搬运而非计算的问题，利用专家组合频率高度偏斜、组合内各专家贡献不对称这两点特性，按重要性重排神经元，使一份存储的专家支持多种执行宽度；按热、温、冷组合分配差异化执行；并借助异构宽度把专家加载与计算重叠起来。在 Mixtral-8x7B 与 DeepSeek-MoE-16B 上，同等内存预算下吞吐最高提升 2.1×，相对全宽度推理精度损失控制在 3.6%。结果表明，边缘 MoE 服务需要联合优化保留哪些专家容量以及如何调度专家执行。
arxiv.reason: MoE 推理剪枝与调度协同优化，属高效推理方向，但偏边缘部署落地

arxiv.title: FeatureArc: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Evolving Features
arxiv.abstract: A software feature usually evolves over time: developers extend its first version as new use cases and requirements arrive, and each extension builds on code written earlier. Most feature benchmarks evaluate a single request on a fixed codebase. Feature evolution requires evaluating successive extensions on an agent's own earlier code and checking whether the feature remains correct. We introduce FeatureArc to evaluate coding agents on evolving features, together with a pipeline that constructs its tasks from repository histories. The benchmark combines dependencies between successive stages of the same feature, explicit requirements and interface contracts, and executable checks across four programming languages. The pipeline validates fail-to-pass (F2P) tests for new behavior and pass-to-pass (P2P) tests for existing behavior on the reference code before and after each stage. We evaluated 10 coding agents on 73 manually reviewed tasks of 2 to 10 stages. Each agent works in one persistent session and workspace without external test feedback or rollback. The evaluation reveals a gap between first-stage and whole-feature success: pooled success falls from 62.7% at the first stage to 28.5% when the whole feature is tested on the final code. Trajectory analysis identifies inherited defects as a common failure mechanism, present in 72.9% of failed later stages. These earlier errors often remain undetected: in stages following a failure, agents leave the earlier error unnoticed about 95% of the time, and their self-tests rarely revisit earlier stages. Evolving a feature autonomously, without human checks between stages, therefore remains a substantial challenge for current coding agents. At Tencent, the pipeline extends internal evaluations to this setting and guides the development of Hunyuan, Tencent's family of large language models.
arxiv.titleZh: FeatureArc:面向演进式特性的编码 Agent 基准评测
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有特性级基准多在固定代码库上评测单次请求，而真实特性会随需求不断扩展、每阶段都建立在先前代码之上。FeatureArc 从仓库历史自动构建多阶段任务，同一特性的各阶段之间存在依赖，并给出显式需求与接口契约，覆盖四种编程语言的可执行检查;构建流程在每个阶段前后用参考实现校验新行为的 fail-to-pass 测试与既有行为的 pass-to-pass 测试。在 73 个人工复核任务(2 至 10 阶段)上评测 10 个编码 Agent，每个 Agent 在单一持久会话与工作区中工作、无外部测试反馈与回滚:首阶段汇聚成功率 62.7%，而最终代码上整特性成功率降至 28.5%;轨迹分析显示 72.9% 的后续阶段失败涉及继承缺陷，失败后约 95% 的情况下 Agent 未察觉先前错误，自测也很少回溯早期阶段。
arxiv.reason: 编码 Agent 多阶段演进基准，契合代码智能与 Agent 评测方向

arxiv.title: When Visual Evidence Is Insufficient: How Instructions, Post-Training, and Internal Activations Shape Refusal in Multimodal Language Models
arxiv.abstract: For reliable deployment, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) should recognize when an image provides insufficient evidence to answer a question and withhold unsupported answers. Yet refusal alone is not necessarily evidence of such recognition: models may refuse because of unrelated safety constraints or without identifying the missing evidence. We study how refusal on visually unanswerable questions is shaped by three sources of control: inference-time instructions, post-training, and internal activation interventions. Across three MLLMs on the MoHoBench benchmark, we systematically manipulate the meaning and placement of refusal instructions, compare supervised and preference-based post-training, and intervene on a refusal-related activation direction derived from naturally answered and refused examples. We find that refusal is highly sensitive to both the meaning and placement of instructions, with model-specific changes at the sample level that are obscured by aggregate refusal rates. Evidence-aware and general refusal instructions have stronger effects than an intentionally mismatched safety instruction. Post-training produces larger increases in refusal, but can also induce responses that combine refusal language with attempted answers. In contrast, activation intervention produces smaller yet transferable changes across prompt conditions, without evidence of indiscriminate refusal on tested visually answerable samples. These findings show that refusal is jointly shaped by external instructions, post-training, and internal representations, highlighting the need to disentangle evidence recognition from a model's learned propensity to refuse.
arxiv.titleZh: 当视觉证据不足时：指令、后训练与内部激活如何塑造多模态语言模型中的拒答行为
arxiv.summaryZh: 多模态大模型在图像证据不足时应拒绝作答，但拒答本身未必意味着模型识别到了证据缺失——它可能源于无关的安全约束。研究在MoHoBench上对三个MLLM系统操纵拒答指令的语义与位置，对比监督式与偏好式后训练，并对由自然作答与拒答样本导出的拒答相关激活方向做干预。结果显示：拒答对指令语义与位置高度敏感，样本级变化被总体拒答率掩盖；后训练带来的拒答增幅更大，却可能产生「拒答措辞＋尝试作答」的混合回复；激活干预效果较小但在不同提示条件下可迁移，且未在可作答样本上出现无差别拒答。
arxiv.reason: 多模态拒答与后训练、激活干预的系统实证，贴合对齐与评测方向

arxiv.title: Bayes-Adaptive MDPs for Rollout Allocation to Enhance GRPO Training
arxiv.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has demonstrated strong performance in LLM post-training. However, it allocates a uniform rollout budget to every training question, ignoring variations in question difficulty. As a result, highly difficult questions may receive too few rollouts to generate informative positive reward signals, limiting their contribution to training, while moderately difficult questions often receive more rollouts than necessary. In this work, we formulate the problem of difficulty-aware rollout budget allocation to maximize training utility under the same total rollout budget as standard GRPO. We propose AdaRoll-GRPO, which reformulates rollout allocation as a sequential decision-making problem and leverages a Bayes-adaptive Markov decision process (MDP) to learn an adaptive allocation policy. The learned policy is computed offline and applied during GRPO training without introducing additional online optimization overhead. Extensive experiments on multiple reasoning datasets and LLM architectures demonstrate that AdaRoll-GRPO consistently improves GRPO training performance under a fixed rollout budget, highlighting the effectiveness of adaptive rollout allocation for GRPO in LLM post-training.
arxiv.titleZh: 用于增强GRPO训练的、面向rollout分配的贝叶斯自适应MDP
arxiv.summaryZh: GRPO在后训练中对每个问题分配相同的rollout预算，忽视题目难度差异:高难题采样过少、难以产生有效正奖励信号，中等题则常被过度采样。AdaRoll-GRPO把难度感知的rollout预算分配建模为序贯决策问题，用贝叶斯自适应MDP学习分配策略，策略离线求解、训练时直接套用，不引入额外在线优化开销，目标是在与标准GRPO相同的总rollout预算下最大化训练效用。在多个推理数据集与多种LLM架构上，该方法在固定rollout预算下一致优于GRPO，说明自适应采样预算分配可提升后训练的采样效率。
arxiv.reason: GRPO采样预算分配，直接命中后训练与RLVR方向

arxiv.title: Beyond the Readout: A Latent Numerical Frame Shared Across Modality and Operation
arxiv.abstract: When a multimodal model computes 17+35 from text or 91-39 from a rendered image, it produces the same answer, 52. Does it use one internal concept of number for both, or separate machinery for each path? Similarity metrics such as RSA or CKA cannot settle this question. They give the same score to identical and to rotated directions, and two representations can look alike only because both prepare the same output digits. We therefore use causal interventions. For four conditions (text or image, addition or subtraction), we learn a small subspace of Gemma4-12B-it's residual stream in which swapping coordinates swaps the model's answer. The subspaces answer three questions. First, do the conditions write numbers along the same directions? They do not. Reusing a subspace from text in an image on the same operation recovers only 53.2% of its causal effect. A single rotation and rescaling maps one subspace onto the other and raises recovery to 91.4%, so the conditions share one geometry expressed in different coordinates. Second, does this shared geometry only reflect the digit the model is about to print? To test this, we split each subspace into 9 directions that the output layer reads to choose the next digit and 13 directions that it cannot see. The 13 hidden directions still carry the number, yet changing them barely alters the digit being written. Third, what are these hidden directions for? A model must emit a multi-digit answer one digit at a time, so it can compute the full result early and keep it in reserve. When two numbers share their first digit, swapping the number in the hidden directions leaves the digit being written intact and redirects the next digit in 77.6% of cases. The model thus forms an abstract numerical concept upstream and unfolds it across time: multimodal representations share meaning through relational geometry across distinct coordinate frames.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越读出层:跨模态与跨运算共享的潜在数字框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 多模态模型从文本算 17+35 与从图片算 91-39 能给出同一答案，但两条路径是否共用同一数字概念尚无定论;RSA、CKA 等相似度指标无法区分同向与旋转后的方向，也排除不掉「都在准备输出数字」的混淆。工作改用因果干预，在 Gemma4-12B-it 残差流中为文本或图像、加法或减法四个条件各学一个交换坐标即交换答案的子空间，跨模态直接复用只恢复 53.2% 的因果效应，经一次旋转加缩放对齐后升至 91.4%;子空间还可分出输出层可读的 9 个方向与 13 个不可见方向，后者仍编码数值却不改变当前输出位，首位相同时交换能让下一位以 77.6% 概率被改写，说明模型先形成抽象数值概念再逐位展开。
arxiv.reason: 多模态表征的可解释性因果分析，方法扎实但偏分析

arxiv.title: Displacement Moments and Path-Terminal Separation in Brownian Interpolant Sampling
arxiv.abstract: Brownian stochastic interpolants connect paired endpoint samples, yet their sampling error can depend on displacement moments even when neither endpoint has a first moment. For arbitrary Borel couplings, we prove early-stopped, target-to-output KL guarantees for standard Euler sampling from the true source. A fourth displacement moment gives an explicit $O(N^{-1})$ bound; a second moment suffices for fixed-law convergence as drift error vanishes. For one fixed coupling with no displacement moment above two, original bridge-path KL stays of order one, comparison-path KL is of order $1/\log N$, and terminal KL is at most $C/N^2$ on the same grid. The path decomposition identifies the information about the source discarded by Markov projection. When the original bridge is Markov, current-state Euler sampling instead has a second-moment $O((M_2+d)/N)$ bound; finite-entropy Schroedinger bridges for the probability Brownian reference are included. We also construct a current-state learner with expected output KL consistency from iid endpoint pairs. Numerical diagnostics illustrate the distinct errors. Conditional diffusion identities specify a restoration interface, while image controls find no iterative advantage over cheap probabilistic predictors. Uniform terminal rates for general second-moment couplings remain open.
arxiv.comment: 56 pages, 4 figures; 8-page main text and complete appendices
arxiv.titleZh: 布朗插值采样中的位移矩与路径—终端分离
arxiv.summaryZh: 布朗随机插值连接成对端点样本，但采样误差可能依赖位移矩，即使端点不存在一阶矩。针对任意 Borel 耦合，证明从真实源分布早停的标准 Euler 采样的目标到输出 KL 保证：四阶位移矩给出显式 O(N^{-1}) 界，二阶矩足以在漂移误差消失时保证固定律收敛。构造仅具二阶矩的固定耦合，原始桥路径 KL 保持常数阶、比较路径 KL 为 1/log N 阶、同一网格终端 KL 至多 C/N^2，并给出 Markov 桥下当前状态 Euler 的 O((M2+d)/N) 界及从 iid 端点对学习的一致性结果。路径分解分离路径误差与终端误差，为扩散与随机插值采样提供理论工具；一般二阶矩耦合的一致终端速率仍开放。
arxiv.reason: 扩散/随机插值采样理论，属低分方向且与 LLM 无关

arxiv.title: Constraining the Commit Boundary: A DIO/ODI-Informed Authorization Guardrail for Agentic Entity Resolution
arxiv.abstract: Agentic Entity Resolution (ER) systems iteratively plan actions, retrieve evidence, revise hypotheses, and propose graph mutations. An erroneous identity hypothesis may condition later retrieval and produce apparent confirmation. This paper proposes a Digital Identity Optimization (DIO) and Ontology of Digital Identity (ODI)-informed authorization boundary between evidence available for agent reasoning and evidence eligible to authorize persistent identity-changing mutations. A domain-governed constraint-binding function maps selected reconstruction-failure distinctions to explicit identity-preserving constraints. An abstract two-phase supervisor permits a commit only when claim-specific authorization-eligible evidence supports every required proposition, relevant conflicts are resolved, the operation remains within its authorized scope, and relevant state and policy versions remain valid. Admission as UNVERIFIED does not confer authorization eligibility. Separate claim-specific promotion governs evidentiary use; insufficient support or unresolved material conflict leads to deferral. The contribution is a specification connecting diagnostic-to-constraint mapping, evidence promotion, proposition coverage, conflict handling, scope binding, and commit-time version integrity. A proposed evaluation protocol is designed to assess the mapping's incremental value beyond generic authorization and conventional identifier rules. This is a conceptual architecture without implementation or empirical validation, not a theorem of semantic correctness. Its property depends on domain-policy adequacy, evidence promotion, and enforcement. It does not prevent erroneous hypotheses or hypothesis-conditioned retrieval; dependency-aware evidence flow remains future research.
arxiv.titleZh: 约束提交边界：一种面向智能体实体消解的 DIO/ODI 知情授权护栏
arxiv.summaryZh: 智能体实体消解会迭代规划、检索证据并修改身份假设；其中错误的身份假设会污染后续检索，形成看似确证的假象。为此提出在「供智能体推理使用的证据」与「可授权持久身份变更的证据」之间设置授权边界：用领域治理的约束绑定函数把重建失败类型映射为显式身份保持约束，再由两阶段监督器把关，只有当每条命题都有可授权证据支持、冲突已解决、操作在授权范围内且状态与策略版本仍有效时才允许提交。该工作目前只是概念架构，未实现也未做实证验证。
arxiv.reason: 涉及智能体授权护栏与证据治理，属 Agent 方向擦边但仅概念架构

arxiv.title: Clearing the FoG: Training KG Agents to Retrieve the Evidence Behind Their Answers
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can answer many factual questions correctly, but a correct answer is not necessarily a supported one. For an LLM agent, a knowledge graph (KG) plays two roles: as a source of answers, it supplies facts that the model lacks; as a source of evidence, it supplies the supporting triples that make an answer traceable and auditable. However, existing KG agents treat the KG only as a source of answers: their training data carries answers but not evidence, and their training rewards check the answer but not the retrieved evidence, so agents often answer correctly without retrieving the supporting triples. We propose FoG, a framework that trains KG agents to retrieve the evidence behind their answers. FoG consists of evidence-grounded synthesis, a KG interaction agent, and an evidence-coverage process reward (ECPR): the synthesis recursively hides explicit entities behind verifiable sub-questions, so that every question carries its supporting triples by construction; the agent records the triples returned by the KG; and ECPR credits each supporting triple to the turn that first retrieves it. Experiments on three KGQA benchmarks demonstrate that FoG enables 3B--4B open-source agents to outperform substantially larger baselines in answer accuracy and evidence coverage, with zero-shot cross-KG transfer.
arxiv.titleZh: 拨开FoG迷雾:训练KG Agent检索答案背后的证据
arxiv.summaryZh: KG Agent 的训练数据只带答案、不带证据，奖励也只校验答案，于是模型常常答对却拿不出支撑三元组。FoG 框架用三部分解决这一点:证据锚定的合成把显式实体递归隐藏为可验证子问题，使每道题天然自带支撑三元组;交互 Agent 记录 KG 返回的三元组;证据覆盖过程奖励(ECPR)把每条支撑三元组记到首次检索它的回合。在三个 KGQA benchmark 上，3B–4B 开源 Agent 的答案准确率与证据覆盖率均超过更大的基线，并具备零样本跨 KG 迁移能力。
arxiv.reason: KG Agent 的证据覆盖过程奖励与 Agentic RL 训练，方向扎实

arxiv.title: LinMix: Data Mixing as Linear Domain Attribution
arxiv.abstract: Language model performance depends strongly on the mixture of domains in the pretraining data corpus. Popular data mixing methods select these domain weights by training many small proxy models on random mixes and then fitting a regression model to predict performance from the mix. We recognize this practice as a domain attribution problem, where the regression measures each domain's contribution to the target metric. Through this lens, the standard Dirichlet sampling of proxy data mixes is a poor regression design that requires tuning and cannot support a linear fit for hundreds of domains. Building on classical optimal experimental design, we introduce LinMix, which samples mixes at the vertices of the capped simplex so that each domain is at its cap or absent. This hyperparameter-free vertex sampling decorrelates domain effects, enabling an interpretable linear model whose coefficients are the domain attributions. The optimal mix given by LinMix provably keeps only domains with positive attribution values and requires no search over candidate mixes. We further establish the optimality of vertex sampling, and prove that Dirichlet sampling inflates the attribution error when its mixes concentrate around the prior data mix. Pretraining experiments with 1B-parameter OLMo2 and 4B Qwen3.5 language models show that LinMix outperforms Dirichlet-based data mixing across reasoning, code, and math benchmarks, with relative gains of 46% on MBPP and 14% on GSM8K. At 288 fine-grained domains, only vertex sampling supports a linear fit, and LinMix improves benchmark accuracy by 11% on average over the best nonlinear baseline.
arxiv.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Attributing Model Behavior at Scale
arxiv.titleZh: LinMix：将数据混合视为线性领域归因
arxiv.summaryZh: 预训练数据混合的常见做法是：在随机混合上训练较小的代理模型，再通过回归预测性能来选择领域权重。该工作把这一过程视为领域归因问题，并指出标准 Dirichlet 采样不适合用作回归设计，难以支撑上百个领域的线性拟合。LinMix 基于最优实验设计，在带上限单纯形的顶点处采样混合，也就是让每个领域取上限或缺失；它无需调参就能解耦领域效应，回归系数直接给出领域归因，并且可以证明最优混合只需保留正归因领域，无需搜索候选。在 1B OLMo2 与 4B Qwen3.5 的预训练实验中，LinMix 在推理、代码、数学基准上优于 Dirichlet 方法，MBPP 相对提升 46%、GSM8K 提升 14%；在 288 个细粒度领域下，平均准确率比最佳非线性基线高 11%。
arxiv.reason: 预训练数据混合的方法论工作，含理论与 1B/4B 实证

arxiv.title: How Many and How Much? Contrastive Learning with Negative Samples for Knowledge Graph Embedding
arxiv.abstract: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE), a fundamental technique for knowledge-centric Web and KG-augmented AI applications, is commonly trained through contrastive learning with negative samples to learn discriminative representations. Despite its empirical success, two crucial questions regarding negative samples remain underexplored: (Q1) how many negative samples should be used for each positive sample and (Q2) how much should each negative sample contribute to learning? To answer these questions, we propose RADAR, a novel contrastive learning framework for KGE models with two effective strategies, respectively: (1) Risk-aware negative budget allocation quantifies false-negative sampling risk by modeling an open-world KG as a stochastic partial observation of its closed-world counterpart and adaptively assigns a negative budget to each positive sample based on its risk; (2) Distribution-calibrated negative weighting assigns negative weights by calibrating the weighting strength for each positive based on two complementary characteristics of the negative-score distribution: dispersion and concentration. Extensive experiments on 3 real-world KGs with 4 KGE models reveal that RADAR achieves the best KGE performance on average across all model--KG combinations and reduces sampled false negatives by over 90% compared with conventional fixed-budget methods.
arxiv.titleZh: 多少个与多大？面向知识图谱嵌入的带负样本对比学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对知识图谱嵌入的负样本对比学习中两个未充分探索的问题——每个正样本该配多少负样本、每个负样本该贡献多少——提出RADAR框架。该框架将开放世界KG建模为闭世界KG的随机部分观测以量化假阴性采样风险，并据此为每个正样本自适应分配负样本预算；同时依据负样本分数分布的离散度与集中度校准加权强度。在3个真实KG、4个KGE模型上的全部模型-KG组合中平均取得最佳嵌入性能，采样假阴性相比固定预算方法减少90%以上。
arxiv.reason: 知识图谱嵌入的负采样方法，与LLM后训练/Agent主线仅有边缘关联

arxiv.title: Para-Gaussian Approximations of Random Deep Neural Networks
arxiv.abstract: It is known that randomly initialized neural networks have Gaussian behaviour in the $n\to \infty$ limit. Unfortunately, this approximation can be poor for finite $n$ and gets worse as one goes deeper into the network. In this work, we develop a more accurate approximation that is \emph{slightly} non-Gaussian, which we call the para-Gaussian distribution and is constructed from the Hermite polynomials. We show how this para-Gaussian approximation can lead to a practical recursive method to approximate the deeper layers of the network. Finally, we apply this theory to linear neural networks (where things can be solved exactly) and to ReLU neural networks (where things can be approximated).
arxiv.titleZh: 随机深度神经网络的拟高斯近似
arxiv.summaryZh: 随机初始化神经网络在无限宽极限下呈高斯行为，但有限宽度时该近似会变差，且网络越深越明显。为此构造由 Hermite 多项式给出的轻微非高斯分布——para-Gaussian 分布，并据此建立递归方法近似深层网络输出分布。理论分别用于可精确求解的线性网络和只能近似的 ReLU 网络，说明有限宽度修正可逐层传播。该工作为随机网络初始化与信号传播的有限宽度分析提供了更精细工具。
arxiv.reason: 随机网络有限宽度理论，与LLM主线关联有限

arxiv.title: Channel Selection for Mixture-of-Experts Decoding Needs No Calibration Data
arxiv.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are bottlenecked by loading routed-expert weights from memory during interactive decoding at small batch sizes. Because most intermediate channels in a routed expert contribute little to any single token, channel selectors predict which channels matter and read only their weights, typically keeping channels above a threshold calibrated on offline data. We show that channel selection needs no calibration data. First, a calibrated threshold does not fix how much a selector reads, because the number of channels passing it varies across inputs; Prox with thresholds calibrated for an 18% read budget actually reads only 12.9% on average across our benchmarks. Second, top-k keeps each token's k highest-scoring channels and needs no calibration data. At the calibrated budget, a selector's top-k version matches or beats its threshold version on the same score in 40 of 43 comparisons at 13% and 18% budgets, including all 23 on generation tasks. The top-k versions also avoid the repetition-loop collapse that calibrated thresholds cause on Gemma 4. Calibrating a threshold thus provides neither of the two things selectors use it for: a known read budget and a consistent accuracy gain at that budget. We furthermore introduce a reader built entirely from the model's weights, which screens channels with a ternary sketch and recovers the skipped ones with a low-rank map. Across three post-trained MoE models, our reader retains 98.1% of full-model accuracy at 17.8% of routed-expert reads, with Triton kernels running MoE blocks 1.60 to 1.90x faster than optimized vLLM at batch one and up to 2.69x at larger batches on the same three models.
arxiv.titleZh: MoE 解码的通道选择无需校准数据
arxiv.summaryZh: 小 batch 解码时 MoE 受限于从内存加载路由专家权重，现有通道选择器依赖离线校准阈值决定读取哪些通道。分析显示校准阈值无法锁定读取比例(按 18% 预算校准的 Prox 实测平均只读 12.9%)，而 top-k 选择无需校准数据，43 项比较中 40 项追平或优于阈值版本，23 项生成任务全部胜出，并避免 Gemma 上阈值导致的重复循环崩溃。所提 reader 完全由模型权重构造:三元 sketch 粗筛通道，低秩映射恢复被跳过的通道。三个后训练 MoE 模型上以 17.8% 的专家读取保留 98.1% 精度，Triton kernel 在 batch=1 时比优化后的 vLLM 快 1.60–1.90x，更大 batch 最高 2.69x。
arxiv.reason: MoE 解码效率与通道选择，含 Triton 内核实测加速
